sourceRange.text: 冬十月丙子，立彭城劉胤為汝陰王，奉宋帝後。己卯，車駕殷祠太廟。辛巳，詔曰：「朕嬰綴世務，三十餘歲，險阻艱難，備嘗之矣。末路屯夷，戎車歲駕，誠藉時來之運，實資士民之力。宋元徽二年以來，諸從軍得官者，未悉蒙祿，可催速下訪，隨正即給。才堪餘任者，訪洗量序。若四州士庶，本鄉淪陷，簿籍不存，尋校無所，可聽州郡保押，從實除奏。荒遠闕中正者，特許據軍簿奏除。或戍扞邊役，末由旋反，聽於同軍各立五保，所隸有司，時為言列。」汝陰太妃王氏薨，追贈為宋恭皇后。

sourceRange.text: 七年春正月丙午，以中軍將軍王敬則為豫州刺史，中軍將軍陰智伯為梁、南秦二州刺史。戊申，詔曰：「雍州頻歲戎役，兼水旱為弊，原四年以前逋租。」辛亥，車駕祠南郊，大赦。京邑貧民，普加賑賜。又詔曰：「春頒秋斂，萬邦所以惟懷，柔遠能邇，兆民所以允殖。鄭渾宰邑，因姓立名，王濬剖符，戶口殷盛。今產子不育，雖炳常禁，比聞所在，猶或有之。誠復禮以貧殺，抑亦情由俗淡。宜節以嚴威，敦以惠澤。主者尋舊制，詳量附定，蠲卹之宜，務存優厚。」壬戌，驃騎將軍、開府儀同三司臨川王映薨。戊辰，詔曰：「諸大夫年秩隆重，祿力殊薄，豈所謂下車惟舊，趨橋敬老。可增俸，詳給見役。

sourceRange.text: 延興元年秋七月丁酉，即皇帝位。以尚書令鎮軍大將軍西昌侯鸞為驃騎大將軍、錄尚書事、揚州刺史、宣城郡公。詔曰：「太祖高皇帝英謀光大，受命作齊；世祖武皇帝宏猷冠世，繼暉下武；世宗文皇帝清明懿鑠，四海宅心：竝德漏下泉，功昭上象，聲教所覃，無思不洽。洪基式固，景祚方融，而天步多阻，運鍾否剝。嗣君昏忍，暴戾滋多，棄侮天經，悖滅人紀，朝野重足，遐邇側視，民怨神恫，宗祧如綴。賴忠謨肅舉，霄漢廓清，俾三后之業，絕而更紐，七百之慶，危而復安。猥以沖人，入纂乾緒，載懷馭朽，若墜諸淵，思與黎元，共綏戬福。」大赦，改元。文武賜位二等。

sourceRange.text: 中興元年春三月乙巳，即皇帝位，大赦，改元。文武賜位二等；鰥寡孤獨不能自存者穀，人五斛。即永元三年也。以相國左長史蕭穎冑為尚書令，晉安王寶義為司空，廬陵王寶源為車騎將軍、開府儀同三司，建安王寶寅為徐州刺史，散騎常侍夏侯詳為中領軍，領軍將軍蕭偉為雍州刺史。丙午，有司奏封庶人寶卷為零陽侯，詔不許。又奏為涪陵王，詔可。乙酉，尚書令蕭穎冑行荊州刺史，假梁王黃鉞。壬子，以征虜將軍柳惔為益、寧二州刺史。己未，以冠軍將軍莊丘黑為梁、南秦二州刺史，冠軍將軍鄧元起為廣州刺史。

sourceRange.text: 戊辰，詔進梁公爵為梁王，增封十郡。三月乙未，皇太后令給梁國錢五百萬，布五千匹，絹千匹。辛丑，鄱陽王寶寅奔虜，邵陵王寶攸、晉熙王寶嵩、桂陽王寶貞伏誅。甲午，命梁王冕十有二旒，建天子旌旗，出警入蹕，乘金根，駕六馬，備五時副車，置旄頭雲罕，樂舞八佾，設鍾簴宮懸。王子王女爵命一如舊儀。庚戌，以冠軍長史蕭秀為南徐州刺史，新除中領軍蔡道恭為司州刺史。車駕東歸至姑熟。丙辰，禪位梁王。丁巳，廬陵王寶源薨。夏四月辛酉，禪詔至，皇太后遜外宮。丁卯，梁王奉帝為巴陵王，宮于姑熟，行齊正朔，一如故事。戊辰，薨，年十五。追尊為齊和帝，葬恭安陵。

sourceRange.text: 晉武太始二年，有司奏，故事皇后諱與帝諱俱下。詔曰，禮內諱不出宮，近代諱之也。建元元年，太常上朝堂諱訓。僕射王儉議曰：「后諱依舊不立訓。禮天子諸侯諱羣祖，臣隸既有從敬之義，宜為太常府君諱。至於朝堂榜題，本施至極，既（迨）〔追〕尊所不及，禮降於在三，晉之京兆，宋之東安，不列榜題。孫毓議稱京兆列在正廟，臣下應諱，而不上榜。宋初博士司馬道敬議東安府君諱宜上榜，何承天執不同，即為明據。」其有人名地名犯太常府君及帝后諱者，皆改。宣帝諱同。二名不偏諱，所以改承明門為北掖，以榜有「之」字與「承」竝。東宮承華門亦改為宣華云。

sourceRange.text: 領郡如左：南東海郡郯祝其襄賁利成西隰丹徒武進晉陵郡晉陵無錫延陵曲阿暨陽南沙海陽義興郡，割屬揚州，後復舊。陽羨臨津國山義鄉綏安南琅邪郡本治金城，永明徙治白下。臨沂江乘蘭陵承省譙，平陽郡流民在臨江郡者，立宣祚縣，尋改爲譙。，省懷化一縣幷屬。臨淮郡自此以下，郡無實土。海西射陽淩淮陰東陽淮浦省淮陵郡司吾武陽，省泰山郡屬。甄城陽樂徐建武三年省南東莞郡東莞莒姑幕建武三年省南清河郡南徐州領冀州東武城清河貝丘繹幕建武二年省南彭城郡彭城武原傅陽蕃薛開陽洨僮下邳建武三年省呂省杼秋建武四年省北陵建武四年省南高平郡宋太始五年僑置，初寄治淮陰，復徙淮南當塗二縣僑屬南豫，後屬南徐。金鄉高平南濟陰郡城武單父城陽建武三年省南濮陽郡廩丘東燕會鄄城建武三年，省濟陽郡度屬。榆次建武二年省南魯郡建武二年省魯樊西安建武二年省南平昌郡建武三年省安丘郡省，屬東莞。新樂郡省，屬東莞。東武高密南泰山郡建武三年省南城郡省，度屬平昌，尋又省。廣平南濟陽郡建武三年省考城郡省，度屬魯，尋又省。晉元帝，刺史祖約避胡賊，自譙還治壽春。

sourceRange.text: 鎮長沙郡。湘川之奧，民豐土閑。晉永嘉元年，分荊州置，苟眺爲刺史。此後三省，輙復置。元嘉十八年置，至今爲舊鎮。南通嶺表，脣齒荊區。領郡如左：長沙郡臨湘羅湘陰醴陵劉陽建寧吳昌桂陽郡郴臨武南平耒陽晉寧汝城零陵郡泉陵洮陽零陵祁陽觀陽永昌應陽衡陽郡湘西益陽湘鄉新康衡山營陽郡營道泠道營浦舂陵湘東郡茶陵新寧攸臨蒸重安陰山邵陵郡都梁邵陵高平武剛建興邵陽扶始興郡曲江桂陽仁化陽山令階含洭靈溪中宿湞陽始興臨賀郡臨賀馮乘富川封陽謝沐興安寧新開建撫寧始安郡本名始建，齊改。始安荔浦建陵左縣熙平永豐平樂齊熙郡鎮南鄭。魏景元四年平蜀所置也。晉永嘉元年，蜀賊沒漢中，刺史張光治魏興，三年，還漢中。建興元年，又爲氐楊難敵所沒。桓溫平蜀，復舊土。後爲譙縱所沒，縱平復舊。每失漢中，刺史輙鎮魏興。漢中爲巴蜀扞蔽，故劉備得漢中，云「曹公雖來，無能爲也」。是以蜀有難，漢中輙沒。雖時還復，而戶口殘耗。宋元嘉中，甄法護爲氐所攻，失守。蕭思話復還漢中。後氐虜數相攻擊，關隴流民，多避難歸化，於是民戶稍實。州境與氐、胡相隣，亦爲威御之鎮。領郡如左：漢中郡南鄭城固沔陽西鄉西上庸魏興郡西城旬陽興晉廣昌南廣城《永元志》無廣城新興郡《永元二年志》無吉陽東關南新城郡房陵綏陽昌魏祁鄉閬陽樂平上庸郡上庸武陵齊安北巫上廉微陽新豐新安吉陽晉壽郡晉壽邵歡興安白水華陽郡宕渠華陽興宋嘉昌新巴郡新巴晉城晉安北巴西郡閬中安漢宋壽南國西國平周漢昌巴渠郡宣漢晉興始興巴渠東關始安下蒲懷安郡懷安義存宋熙郡興平宋安陽安元壽嘉昌《永元志》無白水郡晉壽新巴漢德益昌興安平周南上洛郡上洛商流風民北豐陽渠陽義陽北上洛郡上洛商豐陽《永元志》無流民秬陽陽亭齊化西豐陽東鄴陽齊寧《永元志》無京兆新寧《永元志》無新附安康郡安康寧都南宕渠郡宕渠漢安宣漢宋康懷安郡永豐綏成預德北陰平郡陰平平武南陰平郡陰平懷舊齊興郡齊興《永元志》無安昌《永元志》無鄖鄉錫安富略陽晉昌郡安晉宣漢吉陽萇壽東關新興延壽安樂東晉壽郡:右一郡，縣邑事亡。弘農郡東昌魏郡略陽郡北梓潼郡廣長郡弎水郡思安郡宋昌郡建寧郡南泉郡三巴郡江陵郡懷化郡歸寧郡東楗郡北宕渠郡宋康郡南漢郡南梓潼郡始寧郡江陽郡南部郡南安郡建安郡壽陽郡南陽郡宋寧郡歸化郡始安郡平南郡懷寧郡新興郡南平郡齊兆郡齊昌郡新化郡寧章郡隣溪郡京兆郡義陽郡歸復郡安寧郡東宕渠郡宋安郡齊安郡凡四十五郡，荒或無民戶。

sourceRange.text: 領郡如左：南郡江陵華容枝江臨沮編當陽南平郡孱陵作唐江安安南天門郡零陽澧陽臨澧漊中宜都郡夷道佷山夷陵宜昌南義陽郡平氏厥西河東郡聞喜松滋譙永安汶陽郡僮陽沮陽高安新興郡定襄新豐廣牧永寧郡長寧上黃武寧郡樂鄉長林三峽險隘，山蠻寇賊，宋泰始三年，議立三巴校尉以鎮之。後省，昇明二年，復置。建元二年，分荊州巴東、建平，益州巴郡爲州，立刺史，而領巴東太守，又割涪陵郡屬。永明元年省，各還本屬焉。巴東郡魚復朐南浦聶陽巴渠新浦漢豐建平郡巫秭歸北井秦昌沙渠新鄉巴郡江州枳墊江臨江涪陵郡漢平涪陵漢玫鎮夏口，舊要害也。吳置督將爲魯口屯，對魯山岸，因爲名也。晉永嘉中，荊州刺史都督山簡自襄陽避賊奔夏口，庾翼爲荊州，治夏口，並依地嶮也。太元中，荊州刺史桓沖移鎮上明，上表言：「氐賊送死之日，舊郢以北，堅壁相望，待以不戰。江州刺史桓嗣宜進屯夏口，據上下之中，於事爲便。」義熙元年，冠軍將軍劉毅以爲夏口二州之中，地居形要，控接湘川，邊帶溳、沔，請幷州刺史劉道規鎮夏口。夏口城據黃鵠磯，世傳仙人子安乘黃鵠過此上也。邊江峻險，樓櫓高危，瞰臨沔、漢，應接司部，宋孝武置州於此，以分荊楚之勢。領郡如左：江夏郡沙陽蒲圻灄陽汝南沌陽惠懷竟陵郡竟陵雲杜霄城萇壽新市新陽武陵郡沅陵臨沅零陵辰陽酉陽沅南漢壽龍陽㵲陽黚陽巴陵郡下雋州陵巴陵監利武昌郡武昌鄂陽新義寧寄治鄂真陽《永明三年戶口簿》無西陽郡西陵蘄陽西陽孝寧期思《永明三年戶口簿》無義安左縣希水左縣東安左縣蘄水左縣齊興郡永明三年置綏懷齊康葺波綏平齊寧上蔡《永明三年戶口簿》無東䍧牱郡《永明三年戶口簿》云「新置，無屬縣」。宜南平陽西新市南新市西平陽東新市方城左郡城陽歸義北新陽郡西新陽安吉長寧義安左郡綏安南新陽左郡南新陽新興北新陽角陵新安北遂安左郡《永明三年簿》云「五縣皆缺」。東城綏化富城南城新安新平左郡平陽新市安城建安左郡霄城鎮義陽。

sourceRange.text: 永明八年，納為臨汝公夫人。鬱林即位，為新安王妃。延興元年，為皇后。其年，降為海陵王妃。

localRange.text: 永明八年，納爲臨汝公夫人。鬱林卽位，爲新安王妃。延興元年，爲皇后。其年，降爲海陵王妃。

context.beforeSource: 海陵王王妃名韶明，琅邪臨沂人，太常慈女也。
context.afterSource: 明敬劉皇后諱惠端，彭城人，光祿大夫道弘孫也。

sourceRange.text: 后少與豫章王妃庾氏為娣姒，庾氏勤女工，奉事太祖、昭后恭謹不倦，后不能及，故不為舅姑所重，世祖家好亦薄焉。性剛嚴，竟陵王子良妃袁氏布衣時有過，后加訓罰。昇明三年，為齊世子妃。建元元年，為皇太子妃。三年，后薨。諡穆妃，葬休安陵。世祖即位，追尊皇后。贈璣之金紫光祿大夫，后母檀氏餘杭廣昌鄉元君。

context.beforeSource: 父璣之，左軍參軍。
context.afterSource: 舊顯陽、昭陽〔二〕殿，太后、皇后所居也。
context.beforeLocal: 父璣之，左軍參軍。
context.afterLocal: 舊顯陽、昭陽二殿，太后、皇后所居也。

manualTranslations.zh: 后少與豫章王妃庾氏為娣姒，庾氏勤女工，奉事太祖、昭后恭謹不倦，后不能及，故不為舅姑所重，世祖家好亦薄焉。
manualTranslations.literal: In youth the empress was sisters-in-law with Lady Yu of the Prince of Yuzhang; Yu diligently practiced women's crafts and served the Grand Ancestor and Empress Zhao with tireless reverence—the empress could not match her, so she was not valued by her husband's parents, and Shizong's regard for the household was likewise slight.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In youth she was sisters-in-law with Lady Yu, consort of the Prince of Yuzhang; Yu worked diligently at women's crafts and served the Grand Ancestor and Empress Zhao with tireless reverence. The empress could not match her, so her husband's parents did not value her, and Shizong's regard for the household was slight as well.

manualTranslations.zh: 性剛嚴，竟陵王子良妃袁氏布衣時有過，后加訓罰。
manualTranslations.literal: By nature stern and strict; when Yuan, consort of Prince of Jingling Ziliang, erred while still a commoner, the empress added reproof and punishment.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: She was stern and strict by nature; when Yuan, consort of Prince of Jingling Ziliang, blundered while still a commoner, the empress rebuked and punished her.

manualTranslations.zh: 昇明三年，為齊世子妃。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third year of Shengming she became consort to the Qi heir apparent.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Shengming year 3 she became consort to the Qi heir apparent.

manualTranslations.zh: 建元元年，為皇太子妃。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Jianyuan she became consort to the crown prince.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Jianyuan she became consort to the crown prince.

manualTranslations.zh: 三年，后薨。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third year the empress died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In year 3 the empress died.

manualTranslations.zh: 諡穆妃，葬休安陵。
manualTranslations.literal: She was given the posthumous title Consort Mu and buried at Xiu'an Mausoleum.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: She was posthumously titled Consort Mu and buried at Xiu'an Mausoleum.

manualTranslations.zh: 世祖即位，追尊皇后。
manualTranslations.literal: When Shizong took the throne she was posthumously honored as empress.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Shizong acceded she was posthumously honored as empress.

manualTranslations.zh: 贈璣之金紫光祿大夫，后母檀氏餘杭廣昌鄉元君。
manualTranslations.literal: Jizhi was given the post of household minister with the purple-gold seal; the empress's mother, the Tan clan, was made Village Lady of Guangchang in Yuhang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Pei Jizhi was made household minister with the purple-gold seal, and the empress's mother, née Tan, Village Lady of Guangchang in Yuhang.

sourceRange.text: 宋世，太祖為文惠太子納后，桂陽賊至，太祖在新亭，傳言已沒，宅復為人所抄掠，文惠太子、竟陵王子良奉穆后、庾妃及后挺身送后兄昺之家，事平乃出。建元元年，為南郡王妃。四年，為皇太子妃，無寵。太子為宮人製新麗衣裳及首飾，而后牀帷陳設故舊，釵鑷十餘枚。永明十一年，為皇太孫太妃。鬱林即位，尊為皇太后，稱宣德宮。贈后父金紫光祿大夫，母桓氏豐安縣君。其年十二月，備法駕謁太廟。高宗即位，出居鄱陽王故第，為宣德宮。永元三年，梁王定京邑，迎后入宮稱制，至禪位。天監十一年，薨，年五十八。葬崇安陵。諡曰安后。兄晃義興太守。鬱林王何妃名婧英，廬江𤄵人，撫軍將軍戢之女也。

localRange.text: 鬱林王何妃名婧英，廬江灊人，撫軍將軍戢之女也。

context.beforeSource: 父曄之，太宰祭酒。
context.afterSource: 永明二年，納為南郡王妃。
context.beforeLocal: 父曄之，太宰祭酒。
context.afterLocal: 永明二年，納爲南郡王妃。

manualTranslations.zh: 宋世，太祖為文惠太子納后，桂陽賊至，太祖在新亭，傳言已沒，宅復為人所抄掠，文惠太子、竟陵王子良奉穆后、庾妃及后挺身送后兄昺之家，事平乃出。
manualTranslations.literal: In the Song age the Grand Ancestor received the empress in marriage for Crown Prince Wenhui. When the Guiyang rebels arrived, the Grand Ancestor was at Xinting; rumor spread that he had perished, and the residence was again plundered. Crown Prince Wenhui and Prince of Jingling Ziliang, escorting Empress Mu, Lady Yu, and the empress, braved danger to deliver them to the empress's brother Bing's house; when the affair was settled they emerged.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the Song era the Grand Ancestor took her in marriage for Crown Prince Wenhui. When the Guiyang rebels came, the Grand Ancestor was at Xinting; rumor said he had perished, and the residence was plundered again. Crown Prince Wenhui and Prince of Jingling Ziliang, escorting Empress Mu, Lady Yu, and the empress, risked themselves to take them to the empress's brother Bing's house; when order was restored they came out.

manualTranslations.zh: 建元元年，為南郡王妃。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Jianyuan she became consort to the Prince of Nan commandery.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Jianyuan she became consort to the Prince of Nan commandery.

manualTranslations.zh: 四年，為皇太子妃，無寵。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fourth year she became consort to the crown prince, without favor.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In year 4 she became consort to the crown prince, without favor.

manualTranslations.zh: 太子為宮人製新麗衣裳及首飾，而后牀帷陳設故舊，釵鑷十餘枚。
manualTranslations.literal: The crown prince had new splendid garments and hair ornaments made for palace women, while the empress's bed curtains and furnishings remained old, with a dozen or so hairpins and tweezers.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The crown prince had new splendid garments and ornaments made for palace women, while the empress's bed curtains and furnishings stayed old, with only a dozen or so hairpins and tweezers.

manualTranslations.zh: 永明十一年，為皇太孫太妃。
manualTranslations.literal: In the eleventh year of Yongming she became grand consort to the imperial grandson's heir.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Yongming year 11 she became grand consort to the imperial grandson's heir.

manualTranslations.zh: 鬱林即位，尊為皇太后，稱宣德宮。
manualTranslations.literal: When Yulin took the throne she was honored as empress dowager, styled Xuande Palace.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Yulin acceded she was honored as empress dowager, styled Xuande Palace.

manualTranslations.zh: 贈后父金紫光祿大夫，母桓氏豐安縣君。
manualTranslations.literal: Her father was given the post of household minister with the purple-gold seal; her mother, the Huan clan, was made County Lady of Feng'an.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Her father was made household minister with the purple-gold seal, and her mother, née Huan, County Lady of Feng'an.

manualTranslations.zh: 其年十二月，備法駕謁太廟。
manualTranslations.literal: That year, in the twelfth month, with full imperial equipage she paid homage at the Great Temple.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That year, in the twelfth month, with full imperial equipage she visited the Great Temple.

manualTranslations.zh: 高宗即位，出居鄱陽王故第，為宣德宮。
manualTranslations.literal: When Gaozong took the throne she moved out to the former residence of the Prince of Poyang, styled Xuande Palace.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Gaozong acceded she moved to the former residence of the Prince of Poyang, styled Xuande Palace.

manualTranslations.zh: 永元三年，梁王定京邑，迎后入宮稱制，至禪位。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third year of Yongyuan the Prince of Liang secured the capital; he welcomed the empress into the palace to hold regency, until the abdication of the throne.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Yongyuan year 3 the Prince of Liang secured the capital, welcomed the empress into the palace to rule in regency, and held power until the abdication.

manualTranslations.zh: 天監十一年，薨，年五十八。
manualTranslations.literal: In the eleventh year of Tianjian she died, aged fifty-eight.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Tianjian year 11 she died, aged fifty-eight.

manualTranslations.zh: 葬崇安陵。
manualTranslations.literal: She was buried at Chong'an Mausoleum.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: She was buried at Chong'an Mausoleum.

manualTranslations.zh: 諡曰安后。
manualTranslations.literal: Her posthumous title was Empress An.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: She was posthumously titled Empress An.

manualTranslations.zh: 兄晃義興太守。
manualTranslations.literal: Her older brother Huang was administrator of Yixing.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Her elder brother Huang was administrator of Yixing.

sourceRange.text: 太祖為高宗納之。

localRange.text: 太祖爲高宗納之。

sourceRange.text: 后母桓氏夢吞玉勝生后，時有紫光滿室，以告壽之，壽之曰：「恨非是男。」桓曰：「雖女，亦足興家矣。」后每寢臥，家人常見上如有雲氣焉。年十餘歲，歸太祖，嚴正有禮法，家庭肅然。宋泰豫元年殂，年五十。歸葬宣帝墓側，今泰安陵也。門生王清與墓工始下鍤，有白兔跳起，尋之不得，及墳成，兔還栖其上。昇明二年，贈竟陵公國夫人。三年，贈齊國妃，印綬如太妃。建元元年，尊諡昭皇后。三年，贈后父金紫光祿大夫，母桓氏上〔虞〕都鄉君；壽之子興道司徒屬，文蔚豫章內史，義徽光祿大夫，義倫通直郎。

context.beforeSource: 祖玄之，父壽之，竝員外郎。
context.afterSource: 武穆裴皇后諱惠昭，河東聞喜人也。
context.beforeLocal: 祖玄之，父壽之，竝員外郎。
context.afterLocal: 武穆裴皇后諱惠昭，河東聞喜人也。

manualTranslations.zh: 后母桓氏夢吞玉勝生后，時有紫光滿室，以告壽之，壽之曰：「恨非是男。」
manualTranslations.literal: The empress's mother, the Huan clan, dreamed she swallowed a jade hair ornament when bearing the empress; at that time purple light filled the room. She told Liu Shouzhi, and Shouzhi said, "I regret it was not a boy."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The empress's mother, née Huan, dreamed she swallowed a jade ornament when bearing her; purple light filled the room. She told Liu Shouzhi, who said, "I regret it was not a boy."

manualTranslations.zh: 桓曰：「雖女，亦足興家矣。」
manualTranslations.literal: Huan said, "Though a girl, she is enough to raise the family."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Huan replied, "Though a girl, she is enough to raise the family."

manualTranslations.zh: 后每寢臥，家人常見上如有雲氣焉。
manualTranslations.literal: Whenever the empress slept, her family often saw above her something like cloud vapor.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Whenever she slept, her family often saw cloudlike vapor above her.

manualTranslations.zh: 年十餘歲，歸太祖，嚴正有禮法，家庭肅然。
manualTranslations.literal: In her teens she went to the Grand Ancestor's household; stern, correct, and observant of ritual, the family was awed into order.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In her teens she entered the Grand Ancestor's household; stern, correct, and observant of ritual, she kept the family in awe.

manualTranslations.zh: 宋泰豫元年殂，年五十。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Taiyu of Song she died, aged fifty.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Taiyu of Song she died, aged fifty.

manualTranslations.zh: 歸葬宣帝墓側，今泰安陵也。
manualTranslations.literal: She was buried beside Emperor Xuan's tomb—what is now Taian Mausoleum.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: She was buried beside Emperor Xuan's tomb, at what is now Taian Mausoleum.

manualTranslations.zh: 門生王清與墓工始下鍤，有白兔跳起，尋之不得，及墳成，兔還栖其上。
manualTranslations.literal: When her student Wang Qing and the grave workers first struck the spade, a white hare leaped up; they searched but could not find it, and when the mound was finished the hare returned and nested upon it.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When her student Wang Qing and the grave workers first dug, a white hare leaped up; they searched in vain, and when the mound was finished the hare returned to nest on it.

manualTranslations.zh: 昇明二年，贈竟陵公國夫人。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second year of Shengming she was posthumously given the title Lady of the Duke of Jingling's state.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Shengming year 2 she was posthumously made Lady of the Duke of Jingling's state.

manualTranslations.zh: 三年，贈齊國妃，印綬如太妃。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third year she was made Princess Consort of Qi, with seals and cords like a grand consort.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In year 3 she was made princess consort of Qi, with seals and cords like a grand consort.

manualTranslations.zh: 建元元年，尊諡昭皇后。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Jianyuan she was honored with the posthumous title Empress Zhao.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Jianyuan she was posthumously honored as Empress Zhao.

manualTranslations.zh: 三年，贈后父金紫光祿大夫，母桓氏上〔虞〕都鄉君；
manualTranslations.literal: In the third year her father was given the post of household minister with the purple-gold seal; her mother, the Huan clan, was made Chief Village Lady of Duxiang in Shangyu;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In year 3 her father was made household minister with the purple-gold seal, and her mother, née Huan, Chief Village Lady of Duxiang in Shangyu;

manualTranslations.zh: 壽之子興道司徒屬，文蔚豫章內史，義徽光祿大夫，義倫通直郎。
manualTranslations.literal: Shouzhi's sons Xingdao, a clerk of the minister of works, Wenwei, interior secretary of Yuzhang, Yihui, household minister, and Yilun, attendant who transmits straight.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Shouzhi's sons Xingdao, clerk of the minister of works; Wenwei, interior secretary of Yuzhang; Yihui, household minister; and Yilun, regular attendant in the transmission office.

sourceRange.text: 澄字彥道。初，湛之尚始安公主，薨，納側室郭氏，生淵，後尚吳郡公主，生澄。淵事主孝謹，主愛之，湛之亡，主表淵爲嫡。澄尚宋文帝女廬江公主，拜駙馬都尉。歷官清顯。善醫術，建元中，爲吳郡太守，豫章王感疾，太祖召澄爲治，立愈。尋遷左民尚書。淵薨，澄以錢萬一千，就招提寺贖太祖所賜淵白貂坐褥，壞作裘及纓，又贖淵介幘犀導及淵常所乘黃牛，永明元年，爲御史中丞袁彖所奏，免官禁錮，見原。遷侍中，領右軍將軍，以勤謹見知。其年卒。澄女爲東昏皇后。永元元年，追贈金紫光祿大夫。

sourceRange.text: 詔曰：敬兒蠢茲邊裔，昏迷不脩。屬值宋季多難，頗獲野戰之力。拔迹行伍，超登非分。而愚躁無已，矜伐滋深。往莅本州，久苞異志。在昔含弘，庶能懲革。位班三槐，秩窮五等，懷音靡聞，奸回屢構。去歲迄今，嫌貳滋甚。鎮東將軍敬則、丹陽尹安民每侍接之日，陳其凶狡，必圖反噬。朕猶謂恩義所感，本質可移。頃者已來，釁戾遂著，自以子弟在西，足動殊俗，招扇羣蠻，規擾樊、夏。假託妖巫，用相震惑，妄設徵祥，潛圖問鼎。履霜於開運之辰，堅冰於嗣業之世，此而可忍，孰不可容！天道禍淫，逆謀顯露。建康民湯天獲商行入蠻，備睹姦計，信驛書翰，證驗炳明。便可收掩，式正刑辟；同黨所及，特皆原宥。

時攸之遺太祖書曰：quote|吾聞魚相忘於江湖，人相忘於道術，彼我可謂通之矣。大明之中，謬奉聖主，忝同侍衞，情存契闊，義著斷金，乃分帛而衣，等糧而食。值景和昏暴，心爛形燋，若斯之苦，寧可言盡。吾自分碎首於閣下，足下亦懼滅族於舍人。爾時盤石之心旣固，義無貳計，蹙迫時難，相引求全。天道矜善，此理不空。結姻之始，實關於厚。及明帝龍飛，諸人皆爲鬼矣。吾與足下，得蒙大造，親過夙眷，遇若代臣，錄其心迹，復忝驅使，臨崩之日，吾豫在遺託，加榮授寵，恩深位高。雖復情謝古人，粗識忠節，誓心仰報，期之必死。此誠志竟未申遂，先帝登遐，微願永奪。自爾已來，與足下言面殆絕，非唯分張形迹，自然至此，脫枉一告，未常不對紙流涕，豈願相誚於今哉。苟有所懷，不容不白。初得賢子賾疏，云得家信，云足下有廢立之事，安國寧民，此功巍巍，非吾等常人所能信也。俄奉皇太后假令，云足下潛構深略，獨斷懷抱，一何能壯。但冠雖弊，不可承足，蓋共尊高故耳。足下交結左右，親行殺逆，以免身患。卿當謂龍逢、比干，癡人耳。凡廢立大事，不可廣謀，但袁、褚遺寄，劉又國之近戚，數臣地籍實爲膏腴，人位竝居時望，若此不與議，復誰可得共披心胷者哉？昏明改易，自古有之，豈獨大宋中屯邪？前代盛典，煥盈篇史，請爲足下言之。羣公共議，宜啓太后，奉令而行，當以王禮出第。足下乃可不通大理，要聽君子之言，豈可罔滅天理，一何若茲？孝經云「資於事父以事君」。縱爲宗社大計，不爾，寧不識有君親之意邪？乃復慮以家危，啗以爵賞，小人無狀，遂行弒害。吾雖寡識，竊求古比，豈有爲臣而有近日之事邪？使一旦荼毒，身首分離，生自可恨，死者何罪？且有登齋之賞，此科出於何文？凡在臣隷，誰不惋駭。華夷扣心，行路泣血。乃至不殯，使流蟲在戶，自古以來，此例有幾？衞國微小，故有弘演，不圖我宋，獨無其人。撫膺惆悵，不能自已。足下與向之殺者何異？人情易反，還成嗟悲，爲子君者，無乃難乎！蹊田之譬，豈復有異？管仲有言，君善未嘗不諫。足下諫諍不聞，甘崔杼之罪，何惡逆之苦！昔太甲還位，伊不自疑；昌邑之過，不可稱數，霍光荷託，尚共議於朝班，然後廢之。由有湯沐之施，論者不以劫主爲名。桓溫之心，未忘於篡，海西失道，人倫頓盡，廢之以公，猶禮處之。當溫彊盛，誰能相抗，尚畏懼於形迹，四海不愜，未嘗有樂推之者。伊尹、霍光，名高於臣節，桓氏亦得免於脅奪，凡是諸事，布於書策，若此易曉，豈待指掌。卿常言比迹夷、叔，如何一旦行過桀、跖邪？聖明啓運，蒼生重造，普天率土，誰不歌抃，實是披心罄節、奉公忘私之日。而卿大收宮妓，劫奪天藏，器械金寶，必充私室，移易朝舊，布置私黨，被甲入殿，內外宮閤管籥，悉關家人。吾不知子孟、孔明遺訓如此？王、謝、陶、庾行此舉止？且朱方帝郷，非親不授，足下非國戚也，一旦專縱自樹，云是兒守臺城，父居東府，一家兩錄，何以異此？知卿防固重復，猜畏萬端，言以禦遠，實爲防內。若德允物望，夷貊猶可推心共處，如其失理乖道，金城湯池無所用也。文長以戈戟自衞，何解滅亡。吳起有云：「義禮不脩，舟中之人皆讎也。」足下旣無伍員之痛，苟懷貪惏，而有賊宋之心，吾寧捐申包之節邪？聞求忠臣者必出孝子之門，卿忠孝於斯盡矣！今竊天府金帛以行姦惠，盜國權爵以結人情，且授非其理，合我則賞，此事已復不可恒用，用之旣訖，恐非忠策。且受者不感，識者不知，不能遏姦折謀，誠節慨惋。隔硋數千，無因自對，不能知復何情顏，當與足下敘平生舊款？吾聞前哲絕交，不出惡言，但此自陳名節於胷心，因告別於千載。放筆增歎，公私潸淚，想不深怪往言。然天下耳目，豈伊可誣。抑亦當自知投杖無疆，爲必先及。太祖出頓新亭，報攸之書曰：quote|辱足下誚書，交道不終，爲恥已足。欲下便來，何故多罔君子。吾結髮入仕，豈期遠大，蓋感子路之言，每不擇官而宦。逮文帝之世，初被聖明鑒賞；及孝武之朝，復蒙英主顧眄。因此感激，未能自反。及與足下斂袂定交，款著分好，何嘗不勸慕古人國士之心，務重前良忠貞之節。至於契闊杯酒，殷勤攜袖，薦女成姻，志相然諾，義信之篤，誰與閒之。又乃景和陵虐，事切憂畏，明帝正位，運同休顯，啓臆論心，安危豈貳。元徽之季，聽高道慶邪言，欲相討伐，發威施敕，已行外內。于時臣子鉗口，道路以目。吾以分交義重，患難宜均，犯陵白刃，以相任保。悖主手敕，今封送相示。豈不畏威，念周旋之義耳。推此陰惠，何愧懷抱，不云足下猥含禍詖。前遣王思文所牒朝事，蓋情等家國，共詳衷否，虛心小大，必以先輸。問張雍州遷代之日，將欲誰擬？本是逆論來事，非欲代張，乃封此示張，激使見怒。若張惑一言，果興怨恨，事負雅素，君子所不可爲，況張之奉國，忠亮有本，情之見與，意契不貳邪？又張雍州啓事，稱彼中蠻動，兼民遭水患，敕令足下思經拯之計。吾亦有白，論國如家，布情而往，每思虛達。事之相接，恒必猜離。反謂無故遣信，此乃覘察。平諒之襟，動則相阻，傷負心期，自誰作故？先時足下遣信，尋盟敦舊，厲以篤終，吾止附還白，申罄情本，契然遠要，方固金石。今日舉錯，定是誰恧久言邪？元徽末德，埶亡禋祀，足下備聞，無待亟述。太后惟憂，式遵前誥，興毀之略，事屬鄙躬。黜昏樹明，實惟前則，寧宗靜國，何愧前脩。廢立有章，足下所允，冠弊之譏，將以何語？封爲郡王，寧爲失禮？景和無名，方之不愈乎？龍逢自匹夫之美，伊、霍則社稷之臣，同異相乘，非吾所受也。登齋有賞，壽寂已蒙之於前；同謀獲功，明皇亦行之於昔。此則接踵成事，誰敢異之。謂其大收宮女，劫奪天藏，器械金寶，必充私室。必若虛設市虎，亦可不翅此言；若以此詐民，天下豈患無眼。心苟無瑕，非所耿介。甲杖之授，事旣舊典，豈見有任鎮邦家，勳經定主，而可得出入輕單，不資寵衞！斯之患慮，豈直身憂。祗奉此恩，職惟事理。朱方之牧，公卿僉意，吾亦謂微勳之次，無忝一州。且魏、晉舊事，帝郷蕃職，何嘗豫州必曹，司州必馬？折膠受柱，在體非愧。袁粲據石頭，足下無不可；吾之守東府，來告便謂非。動容見疾，頻笑入戾，乃如是乎！袁粲、劉秉，受遇深重，家國旣安，不思撫鎮，遂與足下表裏潛規，據城之夜，豈顧社稷。幸天未長亂，宗廟有靈，卽與褚衞軍協謀義斷，以時殄滅。想足下聞之，悵然孤沮。小兒忝侍中，代來之澤，遇直上臺，便呼一家兩錄。發不擇言，良以太甚。吾之方寸，古列共言，乃以陶、庾往賢，大見譏責，足下自省，詎得以此見貽邪？比蹤夷、叔，論吾則可，行過桀、蹠，無乃近誣哉！謂吾不朝，此則良誨，朝之與否，想更問之。足下受先帝之恩施，擁戎西州，鼎湖之日，率土載奔，而宴安中流，酣飲自若，卽懷狼望，陵侮皇朝。晉熙殿下，以皇弟代鎮，而斷割候迎，罔蔑宗子，驅略士馬，悉以西上，郢中所遺，僅餘劣弱。昔徵茅不入，猶動義師；況荊州物產，雍、崏、交、梁之會，自足下爲牧，薦獻何品？良馬勁卒，彼中不無，良皮美罽，商賂所聚，前後貢奉，多少何如？唯聞太官時納飲食耳。桂陽之難，坐觀成敗，自以雍容漢南，西伯可擬。賴原卽天世，非望亦消。又招集逋亡，斷遏行侶，治舟試艦，恒以朝廷爲旗的，秣馬桉劔，常願天下有風塵，爲人臣者，固若是邪！至乃不遵制書，敕下如空，國恩莫行，命令擁隔，詔除郡縣，輙自板代，罷官去職，禁還京師。凶人出境，無不千里尋躡，而反募臺將，來必厚加給賞。太妃遣使市馬，齎寶往蜀，足下悉皆斷折，以爲私財，此皆遠邇共聞，暴於視聽。主上叡明當璧，宇縣同慶，絕域奉贄，萬國通書，而盤桓百日，始有單騎，事存送往，於此可徵。不朝如此，誰應受誚？反以見呵，非所反側。今乃勒兵以闚象館，長戟以指魏闕，不亦爲忠臣孝子之所痛心疾首邪？賢子元琰獲免虎口，及凌波西邁，吾所發遣。猶推素懷，不畏嗤嗤。足下尚復滅君臣之紀，況吾布衣之交乎？遂事不諫，旣往難咎。今六師西向，爲足下憂之。

sourceRange.text: 是時虜頻寇雍州，衆軍不捷，失沔北五郡。永泰元年，乃遣顯達北討。詔曰：「晉氏中微，宋德將謝，蕃臣外叛，要荒內侮，天未悔禍，左衽亂華，巢穴神州，逆移年載。朕嗣膺景業，踵武前王，靜言隆替，思乂區夏。但多難甫夷，恩化肇洽，興師擾衆，非政所先，用戢遠圖，權緩北略，冀戎夷知義，懷我好音。而凶丑剽狡，專事侵掠，驅扇異類，蟻聚西偏。乘彼自來之資，撫其天亡之會，軍無再駕，民不重勞，傳檄以定三秦，一麾而臣禹跡，在此舉矣。且中原士庶，久望皇威，乞師請援，結軌馳道。信不可失，時豈終朝。宜分命方岳，因茲大號。侍中太尉顯達，可暫輟槐陰，指授群帥。」中外纂嚴。加顯達使持節，向襄陽。

sourceRange.text: 敬則從入宮，至承明門，門郎疑非蒼梧還，敬則慮人覘見，以刀環塞窐孔，呼開門甚急。衛尉丞顏靈寶窺見太祖乘馬在外，竊謂親人曰：「今若不開內領軍，天下會是亂耳。」門開，敬則隨太祖入殿。明旦，四貴集議，敬則拔白刃在床側跳躍曰：「官應處分，誰敢作同異者！」昇明元年，遷員外散騎常侍、輔國將軍、驍騎將軍、領臨淮太守，增封為千三百戶，知殿內宿衛兵事。

sourceRange.text: 從弟玄謨子瞻，宋明帝世為黃門郎，素輕世祖。世祖時在大床寢，瞻謂豫章王曰：「帳中物亦復隨人寢興。」世祖銜之，未嘗形色。建元元年，為冠軍將軍、永嘉太守，詣闕跪拜不如儀，為守寺所列。有司以啟世祖，世祖召瞻入東宮，仍送付廷尉殺之。遣左右口啟上曰：「父辱子死，王瞻傲慢朝廷，臣輒以收治。」太祖曰：「語郎，此何足計！」旣聞瞻已死，乃默無言。瞻兄寬，宋世與瞻竝為方伯，至是瞻雖坐事，而寬位待如舊也。寬泰始初為隨郡，值西方反，父玄謨在都，寬棄郡歸，明帝加賞，使隨張永討薛安都。寬辭以母猶存，在西為賊所執，請得西行。遂襲破隨郡，斬偽太守劉師念，拔其母。事平，明帝嘉之，使圖畫寬形。建元初，為散騎常侍、光祿大夫，領前軍將軍。永明元年，為太常。坐於宅殺牛，免官。後為光祿大夫。三年，卒。

sourceRange.text: 永明元年，爲吏部尚書。炫居身清立，非弔問不雜交遊，論者以爲美。及在選部，門庭蕭索，賔客罕至。出行，左右捧黃紙帽箱，風吹紙剝僅盡。罷江夏還，得錢十七万，於石頭并分與親族，病無以市藥。國學建，以本官領博士，未拜，卒，無以殯歛。時年四十一。贈太常，諡曰貞子。

sourceRange.text: 世祖卽位，轉吏部尚書，祭酒如故。永明元年，遷金紫光祿大夫，領太常。明年，領南郡王師，加給事中，太常如故。三年，轉太子詹事，師、給事如故。緒每朝見，世祖目送之。謂王儉曰：「緒以位尊我，我以德貴緒也。」遷散騎常侍，金紫光祿大夫、師如故。給親信二十人。復領中正。長沙王晃屬選用吳興聞人邕爲州議曹，緒以資藉不當，執不許。晃遣書佐固請之，緒正色謂晃信曰：「此是身家州郷，殿下何得見逼！」七年，竟陵王子良領國子祭酒，世祖敕王晏曰：「吾欲令司徒辭祭酒以授張緒，物議以爲云何？」子良竟不拜。以緒領國子祭酒，光祿、師、中正如故。

sourceRange.text: 安成恭王暠，字宣曜，太祖第六子也。建元二年，除冠軍將軍，鎮石頭戍，領軍事。四年，出為使持節、督江州豫州之晉熙諸軍事、南中郎將、江州刺史。永明元年，進號征虜將軍。明年，為左衛將軍。尋遷侍中，領步兵校尉。轉中書令。五年，遷祠部尚書，領驍騎將軍。六年，出為南徐州刺史。九年，遷散騎常侍，秘書監，領石頭戍事。暠性清和多疾，其夏薨，年二十四。贈撫軍將軍，常侍如故。鄱陽王鏘，字宣韶，太祖第七子也。建元四年，世祖即位，以鏘為使持節、督雍梁南北秦四州郢州之竟陵司州之隨郡軍事、北中郎將、寧蠻校尉、雍州刺史。永明二年，進號征虜將軍。四年，為左衛將軍，遷侍中，領步兵校尉。七年，轉征虜將軍，丹陽尹。尋加散騎常侍，進號撫軍。出為江州刺史，常侍如故。九年，始親府、州事。加使持節、督江州諸軍事、安南將軍，置佐史，常侍如故。先是二年省江州府，至是乃復。十一年，為領軍，常侍如故。鏘和悌美令，有寵於世祖，領軍之授，齊室諸王所未為。鏘在官理事無壅，當時稱之。車駕游幸，常甲仗衛從，恩待次豫章王嶷。其年，給油絡車。隆昌元年，轉尚書右僕射，常侍如故。俄遷侍中、驃騎將軍、開府儀同三司，領兵置佐。鏘雍容得物情，為鬱林王所依信。鬱林心疑高宗，諸王問訊，獨留鏘謂之曰：「公聞鸞於法身何如？」鏘曰：「臣鸞于宗戚最長，且受寄先帝。臣等年皆尚少，朝廷之干，唯鸞一人，願陛下無以為慮。」鬱林退謂徐龍駒曰：「我欲與公共計取鸞，公既不同，我不能獨辦，且復小聽。」及鬱林廢，鏘竟不知。

localRange.text: 高帝十九男：昭皇后生武帝、豫章文獻王嶷；謝貴嬪生臨川獻王映、長沙威王晃；羅太妃生武陵昭王曄；任太妃生安成恭王暠；陸修儀生鄱陽王鏘、晉熙王銶；袁修容生桂陽王鑠；何太妃生始興簡王鑒、宜都王鏗；區貴人生衡陽王鈞；張淑妃生江夏王鋒、河東王鉉；李美人生南平王銳；第九、第十三、第十四、第十七皇子早亡。衡陽王鈞出繼元王后。

sourceRange.text: 建武之世，高、武子孫憂危，鉉每朝見，常鞠躬俯僂，不敢平行直視。尋遷侍中、衛將軍。鉉年稍長。四年，誅王晏，以謀立鉉為名，免鉉官，以王還第，禁不得與外人交通。永泰元年，上疾暴甚，遂害鉉，時年十九。二子在孩抱，亦見殺。太祖諸王，鉉獨無後，眾竊冤之。乃使揚州刺史始安王遙光、臨川王子晉、竟陵王昭胄、太尉陳顯達、尚書令徐孝嗣、右僕射沈文季、尚書沈淵、沈約、王亮奏論鉉，帝答不許，再奏，乃從之。

sourceRange.text: 宜都王鏗，字宣嚴，太祖第十六子也。初除游擊將軍。永明十年，遷左民尚書。十一年，為持節、都督南豫司二州軍事、冠軍將軍、南豫州刺史，鎮姑熟。時有盜發晉大司馬桓溫女冢，得金蠶銀繭及圭璧等物。鏗使長史蔡約自往修復，纖毫不犯。郁林即位，進號征虜將軍。延興元年見害，年十八。晉熙王銶，字宣攸，太祖第十八子也。永明十一年，除驍騎將軍。隆昌元年，出為持節、督郢司二州軍事、冠軍將軍、郢州刺史。延興元年，進號征虜將軍。尋見害，年十六。

manualTranslations.zh: 少帝以坦之世祖舊人，親信不離，得入內見皇后。
manualTranslations.literal: The young emperor, because Tanzhi was an old associate of the late emperor, kept him in close trust and never let him leave; he was able to enter the inner quarters and see the empress.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Because Tanzhi had been a trusted associate of the late emperor, the young emperor kept him constantly at his side and allowed him into the inner quarters to see the empress.

manualTranslations.zh: 帝於宮中及出後堂雜戲狡獪，坦之皆得在側。
manualTranslations.literal: When the emperor played about in the palace and in the rear hall with mischievous sport, Tanzhi was always able to be at his side.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Whether the emperor played mischievously in the palace or in the rear hall, Tanzhi was always at his side.

manualTranslations.zh: 或值醉後袒，坦之輙扶持諫喻。
manualTranslations.literal: Sometimes when the emperor was drunk and went bare-chested, Tanzhi would support him and remonstrate with him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the emperor was drunk and went bare-chested, Tanzhi would steady him and offer remonstrance.

manualTranslations.zh: 見帝不可奉，乃改計附高宗，密爲耳目。
manualTranslations.literal: Seeing that the emperor could not be served, he then changed his plan and attached himself to Gaozong, secretly serving as eyes and ears.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Seeing that the young emperor was unfit to serve, he shifted his allegiance to Xiao Luan and secretly acted as his informant.

manualTranslations.zh: 除晉安王征北諮議。
manualTranslations.literal: He was appointed Northern Campaign Adviser to the Prince of Jin'an.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was appointed Northern Campaign Adviser to the Prince of Jin'an.

manualTranslations.zh: 隆昌元年，追錄坦之父勳，封臨汝縣男，食邑三百戶。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Longchang, Tanzhi's father Xun was posthumously honored; he was enfeoffed as Baron of Linru with a fief of three hundred households.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Longchang, Tanzhi's father Xun was posthumously honored and enfeoffed as Baron of Linru with a fief of three hundred households.

manualTranslations.zh: 徙征南諮議。
manualTranslations.literal: He was transferred to Southern Campaign Adviser.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Southern Campaign Adviser.

sourceRange.text: 高宗輔政，委以心腹。隆昌元年，自正員郎補丹陽丞，中書郎。高宗爲驃騎，鎮東府，以祏爲諮議參軍，領南平昌太守，與蕭誄對直東府省內。時新立海陵，人情未服，高宗胛上有赤誌，常祕不傳，祏勸帝出以示人。晉壽太守王洪範罷任還，上袒示之，曰：「人皆謂此是日月相。卿幸無泄言。」洪範曰：「公日月之相在軀，如何可隱。轉當言之公卿。」上大悅。會直後張伯、尹瓚等屢謀竊發，祏、誄憂虞無計，每夕輙託事外出。及入纂議定，加祏寧朔將軍。高宗爲宣城王，太史密奏圖緯云「一號當得十四年」。祏入，帝喜以示祏曰：「得此復何所望。」及卽位，遷守衞尉，將軍如故。封安陸縣侯，邑千戶。祏祖遵，以后父贈金紫光祿大夫；父德隣，以帝舅亦贈光祿大夫。

context.afterSource: 建武二年，遷右衞將軍，掌甲仗廉察。

manualTranslations.zh: 高宗輔政，委以心腹。
manualTranslations.literal: When Gaozong served as regent, he entrusted Shi as a trusted confidant.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: While Xiao Luan served as regent, he entrusted Shi as a close confidant.

manualTranslations.zh: 隆昌元年，自正員郎補丹陽丞，中書郎。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Longchang, from full-rank gentleman he was appointed Deputy Magistrate of Danyang and Secretariat Gentleman.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Longchang he was promoted from full-rank gentleman to Deputy Magistrate of Danyang and Secretariat Gentleman.

manualTranslations.zh: 高宗爲驃騎，鎮東府，以祏爲諮議參軍，領南平昌太守，與蕭誄對直東府省內。
manualTranslations.literal: When Gaozong served as Rapid Cavalry General and garrisoned the Eastern Palace quarter, he made Shi Advisory Military Aide, with concurrent office as Administrator of Southern Pingchang, and paired Xiao Tui on duty within the Eastern Palace secretariat.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Xiao Luan served as Rapid Cavalry General at the Eastern Palace quarter, he appointed Shi advisory military aide and Administrator of Southern Pingchang, pairing him on duty in the Eastern Palace secretariat with Xiao Tui.

manualTranslations.zh: 時新立海陵，人情未服，高宗胛上有赤誌，常祕不傳，祏勸帝出以示人。
manualTranslations.literal: At that time Hailing had just been enthroned and popular sentiment was not yet won over. Gaozong had a red mark on his shoulder blade, which he usually kept secret; Shi urged the emperor to bare it and show it to others.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Hailing had just been enthroned and the people were not yet reconciled. Xiao Luan bore a red mark on his shoulder blade that he usually kept secret, and Shi urged him to bare it and show it to others.

manualTranslations.zh: 晉壽太守王洪範罷任還，上袒示之，曰：「人皆謂此是日月相。
manualTranslations.literal: Wang Hongfan, Administrator of Jinshou, returned after leaving office; the emperor bared his shoulder and showed it to him, saying: "Everyone says this is a sun-and-moon configuration.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Wang Hongfan, Administrator of Jinshou, returned after leaving his post. The emperor bared his shoulder and showed him the mark, saying, "Everyone says this is a sun-and-moon configuration.

manualTranslations.zh: 卿幸無泄言。
manualTranslations.literal: I hope you will not let word of it leak out.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Please do not let word of it leak out.

manualTranslations.zh: 」洪範曰：「公日月之相在軀，如何可隱。
manualTranslations.literal: " Hongfan said: "Your sun-and-moon configuration is on your body—how can it be hidden?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: " Hongfan said, "Your sun-and-moon configuration is on your body—how can it be hidden?

manualTranslations.zh: 轉當言之公卿。
manualTranslations.literal: You ought rather to speak of it to the high ministers.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: You ought rather to speak of it to the high ministers.

manualTranslations.zh: 」上大悅。
manualTranslations.literal: " The emperor was greatly pleased.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: " The emperor was greatly pleased.

manualTranslations.zh: 會直後張伯、尹瓚等屢謀竊發，祏、誄憂虞無計，每夕輙託事外出。
manualTranslations.literal: When the direct attendants Zhang Bo, Yin Zan, and others repeatedly plotted a sudden coup, Shi and Tui were anxious and at a loss; each evening they would make excuses to go out.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the direct attendants Zhang Bo, Yin Zan, and others repeatedly plotted a coup, Shi and Tui were anxious and at a loss; each evening they made excuses to go out.

manualTranslations.zh: 及入纂議定，加祏寧朔將軍。
manualTranslations.literal: When the succession was settled, Shi was given the additional title General Who Pacifies the North.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the succession was settled, Shi was additionally made General Who Pacifies the North.

manualTranslations.zh: 高宗爲宣城王，太史密奏圖緯云「一號當得十四年」。
manualTranslations.literal: When Gaozong was Prince of Xuancheng, the court astronomer secretly reported according to charts and omens: "One reign title should last fourteen years."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Xiao Luan was Prince of Xuancheng, the court astronomer secretly reported from charts and omens, "One reign title should last fourteen years."

manualTranslations.zh: 祏入，帝喜以示祏曰：「得此復何所望。
manualTranslations.literal: When Shi entered, the emperor joyfully showed it to him and said: "With this, what more could one hope for?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Shi entered, the emperor joyfully showed him the report and said, "With this, what more could one hope for?

manualTranslations.zh: 」及卽位，遷守衞尉，將軍如故。
manualTranslations.literal: " When he took the throne, Shi was transferred to Commandant of the Guard, retaining his generalship.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: " When he took the throne, Shi was made Commandant of the Guard, retaining his generalship.

manualTranslations.zh: 封安陸縣侯，邑千戶。
manualTranslations.literal: He was enfeoffed as Marquis of Anlu with a fief of a thousand households.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was enfeoffed as Marquis of Anlu with a fief of a thousand households.

manualTranslations.zh: 祏祖遵，以后父贈金紫光祿大夫；
manualTranslations.literal: Shi's grandfather Zun was posthumously honored as Grand Master with Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon because he had been the empress's father.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Shi's grandfather Jiang Zun was posthumously honored as Grand Master with Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon as the empress's father.

manualTranslations.zh: 父德隣，以帝舅亦贈光祿大夫。
manualTranslations.literal: His father Delin was likewise posthumously honored as Grand Master of Splendid Happiness because he was the emperor's maternal uncle.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His father Jiang Delin was likewise posthumously honored as Grand Master of Splendid Happiness as the emperor's maternal uncle.

sourceRange.text: 七年，徙爲侍中，領驍騎將軍，尋轉都官尚書，領驍騎將軍。王晏啓世祖曰：「江斆今重登禮閣，兼掌六軍，慈渥所覃，寔有優忝。但語其事任，殆同閑輩。天旨旣欲升其名位，愚謂以侍中領驍騎，望實清顯，有殊納言。」上曰：「斆常啓吾，爲其鼻中惡。今旣以何胤、王瑩還門下，故有此回換耳。」鬱林卽位，遷掌吏部。隆昌元年，爲侍中，領國子祭酒。鬱林廢，朝臣皆被召入宮，斆至雲龍門，託藥醉吐車中而去。明帝卽位，改領祕書監，又改領晉安王師。

context.beforeSource: 明年，出爲輔國將軍、東海太守，加秩中二千石，行南徐州事。
context.afterSource: 建武二年，卒，年四十四。

manualTranslations.zh: 七年，徙爲侍中，領驍騎將軍，尋轉都官尚書，領驍騎將軍。
manualTranslations.literal: In the seventh year he was transferred to Palace Attendant and concurrently General of Valiant Cavalry; soon he was moved to Minister of Justice while still holding General of Valiant Cavalry.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the seventh year of Yongming he was made Palace Attendant and General of Valiant Cavalry; soon he was transferred to Minister of Justice while retaining the post of General of Valiant Cavalry.

manualTranslations.zh: 王晏啓世祖曰：「江斆今重登禮閣，兼掌六軍，慈渥所覃，寔有優忝。
manualTranslations.literal: Wang Yan reported to Emperor Wu: "Jiang Xiao now returns to the Ritual Pavilion and concurrently commands the Six Armies; the gracious favor lavished on him is truly more than fitting.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Wang Yan reported to Emperor Wu, "Jiang Xiao now returns to the Ritual Pavilion and concurrently commands the Six Armies; the gracious favor shown him is truly more than fitting.

manualTranslations.zh: 但語其事任，殆同閑輩。
manualTranslations.literal: Yet speaking of his duties and responsibilities, they are nearly those of an idle functionary.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yet in terms of his duties and responsibilities, they are nearly those of an idle functionary.

manualTranslations.zh: 天旨旣欲升其名位，愚謂以侍中領驍騎，望實清顯，有殊納言。
manualTranslations.literal: Since Heaven's intent is already to raise his rank and position, I humbly suggest that holding Palace Attendant with Valiant Cavalry is in station clear and prominent, distinct from Director of the Secretariat.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Since Your Majesty already wishes to raise his rank and position, I humbly suggest that Palace Attendant with Valiant Cavalry is in station clear and prominent, distinct from Director of the Secretariat.

manualTranslations.zh: 」上曰：「斆常啓吾，爲其鼻中惡。
manualTranslations.literal: " The emperor said: "Xiao often reported to me that he suffers from nasal affliction.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: " The emperor said, "Xiao often reported to me that he suffers from nasal affliction.

manualTranslations.zh: 今旣以何胤、王瑩還門下，故有此回換耳。
manualTranslations.literal: Now that He Yin and Wang Ying have been restored to the Secretariat, there is this change of posts.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Now that He Yin and Wang Ying have been restored to the Secretariat, there is this reshuffling of posts.

manualTranslations.zh: 」鬱林卽位，遷掌吏部。
manualTranslations.literal: " When Emperor Yulin took the throne, Xiao was transferred to head the Bureau of Personnel.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: " When Emperor Yulin took the throne, Xiao was transferred to head the Bureau of Personnel.

manualTranslations.zh: 隆昌元年，爲侍中，領國子祭酒。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Longchang he became Palace Attendant and concurrently Rector of the National University.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Longchang he was made Palace Attendant and Rector of the National University.

manualTranslations.zh: 鬱林廢，朝臣皆被召入宮，斆至雲龍門，託藥醉吐車中而去。
manualTranslations.literal: When Emperor Yulin was deposed, all court ministers were summoned into the palace; Xiao reached the Cloud Dragon Gate, claimed illness and drunkenness, vomited in his carriage, and departed.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Emperor Yulin was deposed, all court ministers were summoned into the palace; Xiao reached the Cloud Dragon Gate, feigned illness and drunkenness, vomited in his carriage, and left.

manualTranslations.zh: 明帝卽位，改領祕書監，又改領晉安王師。
manualTranslations.literal: When Emperor Ming took the throne, Xiao was changed to Director of the Secretariat and then changed to tutor to the Prince of Jin'an.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Emperor Ming took the throne, Xiao was reassigned as Director of the Secretariat and then as tutor to the Prince of Jin'an.

sourceRange.text: 以疾遷金紫光祿大夫，加親信二十人，常侍如故。轉侍中，領太子詹事，遷中護軍，侍中如故。以家爲府。隆昌元年，復爲領軍將軍，侍中如故。豫廢鬱林，高宗欲以文季爲江州，遣左右單景雋宣旨，文季口自陳讓，稱年老不願外出，因問右執法有人未，景雋還具言之。延興元年，遷尚書右僕射。

sourceRange.text: 晉平王休祐爲南徐州，帝問褚淵須幹事人爲上佐，淵舉文季。轉寧朔將軍、驃騎長史、南東海太守。休祐被殺，雖用薨禮，僚佐多不敢至。文季獨往省墓展哀。出爲臨海太守。元徽初，遷散騎常侍，領後軍將軍，轉祕書監。出爲吳興太守。文季飲酒至五斗，妻王氏，王錫女，飲酒亦至三斗。文季與對飲竟日，而視事不廢。昇明元年，沈攸之反，太祖加文季爲冠軍將軍，督吳興錢塘軍事。攸之先爲景和銜使殺慶之。至是文季收殺攸之弟新安太守登之，誅其宗族。加持節，進號征虜將軍，改封略陽縣侯，邑千戶。明年，遷丹陽尹，將軍如故。齊國初建，爲侍中，領祕書監。建元元年，轉太子右衞率，侍中如故。改封西豐縣侯，食邑千二百戶。

context.beforeSource: 文季不肯飲酒，被驅下殿。
context.afterSource: 文季風采稜岸，善於進止。

sourceRange.text: 兄子昭略，有剛氣。昇明末，爲相國西曹掾，太祖賞之，及卽位，謂王儉曰：「南士中有沈昭略，何職處之？」儉曰：「臣已有擬。」奏轉前軍將軍，上不欲違，可其奏。尋遷爲中書郎。永明初，歷太尉大司馬從事中郎，驃騎司馬，黃門郎。南郡王友、學華選，以昭略爲友，尋兼左丞。元年，出爲臨海太守，御史中丞。昭略建武世嘗酣酒以自晦，與謝善。累遷侍中，冠軍將軍，撫軍長史。永元元年，始安王遙光起兵東府，執昭略於城內。昭略潛自南出，濟淮還臺。至是與文季俱被召入華林省。茹法珍等進藥酒，昭略怒罵徐孝嗣曰：「廢昏立明，古今令典。宰相無才，致有今日。」以甌擲面破，曰「作破面鬼」。死時年四十餘。

context.beforeSource: 中興元年，贈侍中、司空，謚忠憲。
context.afterSource: 弟昭光，聞收至，家人勸逃去，昭光不忍捨母，遂見獲，殺之。

sourceRange.text: 世祖崩，遺詔轉右僕射。隆昌元年，遷散騎常侍、前將軍、丹陽尹。高宗謀廢鬱林，以告孝嗣，孝嗣奉旨無所釐贊。高宗入殿，孝嗣戎服隨後。鬱林旣死，高宗須太后令，孝嗣於袖中出而奏之，高宗大悅。以廢立功，封枝江縣侯，食邑千戶。給鼓吹一部，甲仗五十人入殿。轉左僕射，常侍如故。明帝卽位，加侍中、中軍大將軍，定策勳，進爵爲公，增封二千戶。給班劔二十人，加兵百人。舊拜三公乃臨軒，至是帝特詔與陳顯達、王晏竝臨軒拜授。

context.beforeSource: 臺閣事多以委之。
context.afterSource: 北虜動，詔孝嗣假節頓新亭。

sourceRange.text: 尋遷西陽王征虜、巴陵王後軍、臨汝公輔國三府長史，行府州事。復爲西陽王左軍長史，領會稽郡丞，行郡事。隆昌元年，徙爲晉熙王冠軍長史、江夏內史，行郢州事。慧曉歷輔五政，治身清肅，僚佐以下造詣，趣起送之。或謂慧曉曰：「長史貴重，不宜妄自謙屈。」答曰：「我性惡人無禮，不容不以禮處人。」未嘗卿士大夫，或問其故，慧曉曰：「貴人不可卿，而賤者可卿。人生何容立輕重於懷抱！」終身常呼人位。

sourceRange.text: 江夏王寶玄字智深，明帝第三子也。建武元年，爲征虜將軍，領石頭戍事，封江夏郡王。仍出爲持節、都督郢司二州軍事、西中郎將、郢州刺史。永泰元年，還爲前將軍，領石頭戍事。未拜，東昏卽位，進號鎮軍將軍。永元元年，又進車騎將軍，代晉安王寶義爲使持節、都督南徐兖二州軍事、南徐兖二州刺史，將軍如故。

context.beforeSource: 天監中薨。

manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Jianwu he was made General Who Conquers the Barbarians, took charge of the Stone City garrison, and was enfeoffed as Prince of Jiangxia Commandery.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Jianwu (494) he was appointed General Who Conquers the Barbarians, placed in charge of the Stone City garrison, and enfeoffed as Prince of Jiangxia.

sourceRange.text: 邵陵王寶攸字智宣，明帝第九子也。建武元年，封南平郡王。二年，改封。三年，爲北中郎將，鎮琅邪城。永元元年，爲持節、都督南北徐南兖青冀五州軍事、南兖州刺史，郎將如故。未拜，遷征虜將軍，領石頭戍事。丹楊尹，戍事如故。陳顯達事平，出爲持節、督江州軍事、左將軍、江州刺史。以本號還京師，授中軍將軍，祕書監。中興二年，謀反，宣德太后令賜死。晉熙王寶嵩字智靖，明帝第十子也。永元二年500年，爲冠軍將軍、丹楊尹。仍遷持節、都督南徐兖二州軍事、南徐州刺史，將軍如故。中興元年501年，和帝以爲中書令。明年，謀反伏誅。

manualTranslations.literal: In the third year he was made General of the North and garrisoned Langya City.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the third year (496) he was appointed General of the North and garrisoned Langya City.

manualTranslations.zh: 永元元年，爲持節、都督南北徐南兖青冀五州軍事、南兖州刺史，郎將如故。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Yongyuan he was made Bearer of Credentials, Supervisor of Military Affairs for the five provinces of Northern and Southern Xu, Southern Yan, Qing, and Ji, and Governor of Southern Yan; his rank as commander remained as before.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Yongyuan (499) he was appointed Bearer of Credentials, Area Commander of Northern and Southern Xu, Southern Yan, Qing, and Ji, and Governor of Southern Yan, retaining his rank as commander.

manualTranslations.zh: 未拜，遷征虜將軍，領石頭戍事。
manualTranslations.literal: Before he could accept the appointment, he was transferred to General Who Conquers the Barbarians and took charge of the Stone City garrison.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Before he could take up the post, he was reassigned as General Who Conquers the Barbarians and placed in charge of the Stone City garrison.

manualTranslations.zh: 丹楊尹，戍事如故。
manualTranslations.literal: He was made Governor of Danyang; his garrison duties remained as before.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was appointed Governor of Danyang while retaining his garrison duties.

manualTranslations.zh: 陳顯達事平，出爲持節、督江州軍事、左將軍、江州刺史。
manualTranslations.literal: When Chen Xianda's affair was settled, he went out as Bearer of Credentials, Supervisor of Military Affairs for Jiang Province, General of the Left, and Governor of Jiang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After Chen Xianda's rebellion was suppressed, he was sent out as Bearer of Credentials, Area Commander of Jiang Province, General of the Left, and Governor of Jiang.

manualTranslations.zh: 以本號還京師，授中軍將軍，祕書監。
manualTranslations.literal: With his former title he returned to the capital and was given the posts of General of the Central Army and Superintendent of the Masters of Writing.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He returned to the capital with his former title and was appointed General of the Central Army and Superintendent of the Masters of Writing.

manualTranslations.zh: 中興二年，謀反，宣德太后令賜死。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second year of Zhongxing he plotted rebellion, and Dowager Empress Xuande ordered him granted death.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second year of Zhongxing (502) he plotted rebellion, and Dowager Empress Xuande ordered him put to death.

manualTranslations.zh: 晉熙王寶嵩字智靖，明帝第十子也。
manualTranslations.literal: The Prince of Jinxing, Bao Song, style name Zhijing, was Emperor Ming's tenth son.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Bao Song, Prince of Jinxing, whose style name was Zhijing, was Emperor Ming's tenth son.

manualTranslations.zh: 永元二年，爲冠軍將軍、丹楊尹。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second year of Yongyuan he was made General Who Conquers Champions and Governor of Danyang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second year of Yongyuan (500) he was appointed General Who Conquers Champions and Governor of Danyang.

manualTranslations.zh: 仍遷持節、都督南徐兖二州軍事、南徐州刺史，將軍如故。
manualTranslations.literal: He was then transferred to Bearer of the Staff, Supervisor of Military Affairs for Southern Xu and Yan, and Governor of Southern Xu; his generalship remained as before.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was then reassigned as Bearer of the Staff, Area Commander of Southern Xu and Yan, and Governor of Southern Xu, retaining his rank as general.

manualTranslations.zh: 中興元年，和帝以爲中書令。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Zhongxing Emperor He made him Director of the Secretariat.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Zhongxing (501) Emperor He appointed him Director of the Secretariat.

manualTranslations.zh: 明年，謀反伏誅。
manualTranslations.literal: The next year he plotted rebellion and was executed.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The following year he plotted rebellion and was executed.

sourceRange.text: 巴陵王昭秀字懷尚，太子第三子也。永明中，封曲江公，千五百戶。十年，爲寧朔將軍、濟陽太守。鬱林卽位，封臨海郡王，二千戶。隆昌元年，爲使持節、都督荊雍益寧梁南北秦七州軍事、西中郎將、荊州刺史。延興元年，徵爲車騎將車，衞京師，以永嘉王昭粲代之。明帝建武二年495年，通直常侍庾曇隆啓曰：「周定雒邑，天子置畿內之民；漢都咸陽，三輔爲社稷之衞。中晉南遷，事移威弛，近郡名邦，多有國食。宋武創業，依擬古典，神州部內，不復別封。而孝武末年，分樹寵子，苟申私愛，有乖訓准。隆昌之元，特開母弟之貴，竊謂非古。聖明御宇，禮舊爲先，畿內限斷，宜遵昔制，賜茅授土，一出外州。」詔付尚書詳議。其冬，改封昭秀爲巴陵王。永泰元年498年見殺，年十六。桂陽王昭粲，太子第四子也。鬱林立，以皇弟封永嘉郡王，南徐州刺史。延興元年，出爲使持節、都督荊雍益寧梁南北秦七州軍事、西中郎將、荊州刺史。明帝立，欲以聞喜公遙欣爲荊州，轉昭粲爲右將軍，中書令。建武二年，改封桂陽王。四年，遷太常，將軍如故。永泰元年見殺，年八歲。

context.beforeSource: 褚氏生桂陽王昭粲。

manualTranslations.zh: 巴陵王昭秀字懷尚，太子第三子也。
manualTranslations.literal: The Prince of Baling, Zhaoxiu, style name Huaishang, was the crown prince's third son.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Zhaoxiu, Prince of Baling, whose style name was Huaishang, was Crown Prince Wen Hui's third son.

manualTranslations.zh: 永明中，封曲江公，千五百戶。
manualTranslations.literal: During the Yongming era he was enfeoffed as Duke of Qujiang with fifteen hundred households.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: During the Yongming era he was enfeoffed as Duke of Qujiang with a fief of fifteen hundred households.

manualTranslations.zh: 十年，爲寧朔將軍、濟陽太守。
manualTranslations.literal: In the tenth year he was made General Who Pacifies the North and Governor of Jiyang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he was appointed General Who Pacifies the North and Governor of Jiyang.

manualTranslations.zh: 鬱林卽位，封臨海郡王，二千戶。
manualTranslations.literal: When the Prince of Yulin acceded, he was enfeoffed as Prince of Linhai Commandery with two thousand households.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the Prince of Yulin took the throne, Zhaoxiu was enfeoffed as Prince of Linhai with a fief of two thousand households.

manualTranslations.zh: 隆昌元年，爲使持節、都督荊雍益寧梁南北秦七州軍事、西中郎將、荊州刺史。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Longchang he was made Bearer of the Staff, Supervisor of Military Affairs for the seven provinces of Jing, Yong, Yi, Ning, Liang, and Northern and Southern Qin, General of the West, and Governor of Jing.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Longchang (494) he was appointed Bearer of the Staff, Area Commander of Jing, Yong, Yi, Ning, Liang, and Northern and Southern Qin, General of the West, and Governor of Jing.

manualTranslations.zh: 延興元年，徵爲車騎將軍，衞京師，以永嘉王昭粲代之。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Yanxing he was summoned as General of the Chariots and Cavalry to guard the capital, and the Prince of Yongjia, Zhaocan, was sent to replace him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Yanxing (494) he was recalled as General of the Chariots and Cavalry to guard the capital, and Zhaocan, Prince of Yongjia, replaced him.

manualTranslations.zh: 明帝建武二年，通直常侍庾曇隆啓曰：「周定雒邑，天子置畿內之民；
manualTranslations.literal: In the second year of Jianwu under Emperor Ming, Regular Attendant Yu Tanlong submitted: "When the Zhou fixed their capital at Luoyi, the Son of Heaven placed the people of the capital domain;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second year of Jianwu (495), Regular Attendant Yu Tanlong memorialized: "When the Zhou fixed their capital at Luoyi, the Son of Heaven settled the people of the capital domain;

manualTranslations.zh: 漢都咸陽，三輔爲社稷之衞。
manualTranslations.literal: when Han made its capital at Xianyang, the Three Metropolises were the guard of the altars of state.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: when Han made its capital at Xianyang, the Three Metropolitans guarded the altars of state.

manualTranslations.zh: 中晉南遷，事移威弛，近郡名邦，多有國食。
manualTranslations.literal: When mid-Jin moved south, affairs shifted and authority slackened; famous commanderies near the capital often received state stipends.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After the Jin moved south, authority slackened over time, and famous nearby commanderies often drew state stipends.

manualTranslations.zh: 宋武創業，依擬古典，神州部內，不復別封。
manualTranslations.literal: When Emperor Wu of Song founded the dynasty, following ancient models, within the imperial domain he no longer enfeoffed separately.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Emperor Wu of Song founded the dynasty on ancient models, he ceased granting separate fiefs within the imperial domain.

manualTranslations.zh: 而孝武末年，分樹寵子，苟申私愛，有乖訓准。
manualTranslations.literal: But in the late years of Emperor Xiaowu, enfeoffments were divided to favor beloved sons, indulging private affection against proper norms.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: But in Emperor Xiaowu's later years, favored sons were enfeoffed separately to indulge private affection, contrary to proper norms.

manualTranslations.zh: 隆昌之元，特開母弟之貴，竊謂非古。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Longchang, special honor was opened to younger brothers of the same mother; I privately consider this uncanonical.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Longchang, special rank was granted to younger uterine brothers; I submit that this is uncanonical.

manualTranslations.zh: 聖明御宇，禮舊爲先，畿內限斷，宜遵昔制，賜茅授土，一出外州。
manualTranslations.literal: The sage and enlightened ruler governs the realm; ancient rites come first. The limits of the capital domain should follow former institutions—bestowal of estates and grant of land should all go to outer provinces.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The sage ruler governs the realm with ancient rites foremost; the limits of the capital domain should follow former institutions, and grants of fief and land should all lie outside the inner provinces.

manualTranslations.zh: 」詔付尚書詳議。
manualTranslations.literal: " An edict referred the memorial to the Masters of Writing for detailed deliberation.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: " An edict referred the matter to the Masters of Writing for detailed deliberation.

manualTranslations.zh: 其冬，改封昭秀爲巴陵王。
manualTranslations.literal: That winter Zhaoxiu's enfeoffment was changed to Prince of Baling.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That winter Zhaoxiu was reassigned as Prince of Baling.

manualTranslations.zh: 永泰元年見殺，年十六。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Yongtai he was killed. He was sixteen.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Yongtai (498) he was put to death at the age of sixteen.

manualTranslations.zh: 桂陽王昭粲，太子第四子也。
manualTranslations.literal: Zhaocan, Prince of Guiyang, was the crown prince's fourth son.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Zhaocan, Prince of Guiyang, was Crown Prince Wen Hui's fourth son.

manualTranslations.zh: 鬱林立，以皇弟封永嘉郡王，南徐州刺史。
manualTranslations.literal: When Yulin was established, he was enfeoffed as Prince of Yongjia Commandery as the emperor's younger brother and made Governor of Southern Xu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the Prince of Yulin was installed as emperor, Zhaocan was enfeoffed as Prince of Yongjia as the emperor's younger brother and appointed Governor of Southern Xu.

manualTranslations.zh: 延興元年，出爲使持節、都督荊雍益寧梁南北秦七州軍事、西中郎將、荊州刺史。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Yanxing he went out as Bearer of the Staff, Supervisor of Military Affairs for the seven provinces of Jing, Yong, Yi, Ning, Liang, and Northern and Southern Qin, General of the West, and Governor of Jing.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Yanxing (494) he was sent out as Bearer of the Staff, Area Commander of Jing, Yong, Yi, Ning, Liang, and Northern and Southern Qin, General of the West, and Governor of Jing.

manualTranslations.zh: 明帝立，欲以聞喜公遙欣爲荊州，轉昭粲爲右將軍，中書令。
manualTranslations.literal: When Emperor Ming was established, wishing to make the Duke of Wenxi, Yaoxin, Governor of Jing, he transferred Zhaocan to General of the Right and Director of the Secretariat.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Emperor Ming took the throne, intending to appoint Yaoxin, Duke of Wenxi, to Jing Province, he reassigned Zhaocan as General of the Right and Director of the Secretariat.

manualTranslations.zh: 建武二年，改封桂陽王。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second year of Jianwu his enfeoffment was changed to Prince of Guiyang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second year of Jianwu (495) he was reassigned as Prince of Guiyang.

manualTranslations.zh: 四年，遷太常，將軍如故。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fourth year he was transferred to Grand Minister of Ceremonies; his generalship remained as before.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fourth year (497) he was promoted to Grand Minister of Ceremonies, retaining his rank as general.

manualTranslations.zh: 永泰元年見殺，年八歲。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Yongtai he was killed. He was eight.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Yongtai (498) he was put to death at the age of eight.

sourceRange.text: 高宗爲豫州，叔業爲右軍司馬，加建威將軍、軍主，領陳留太守。七年，爲王敬則征西司馬，將軍、軍主如故。隨府轉驃騎。在壽春爲佐數年。九年，爲寧蠻長史、廣平太守。雍州刺史王奐事難，叔業率部曲於城內起義。上以其有幹用，仍留爲晉安王征北諮議，領中兵，扶風太守，遷晉熙王冠軍司馬。延興元年，加寧朔將軍，司馬如故。

manualTranslations.zh: 高宗爲豫州，叔業爲右軍司馬，加建威將軍、軍主，領陳留太守。
manualTranslations.literal: When Emperor Ming was Inspector of Yuzhou, Shuye became Chief Clerk of the Right Army, was given the additional title General Who Builds Martial Force and army commander, and held Chenliu as prefect.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Emperor Ming held Yuzhou, Shuye became Chief Clerk of the Right Army with the additional titles General Who Builds Martial Force and army commander, and served as Administrator of Chenliu.

manualTranslations.zh: 七年，爲王敬則征西司馬，將軍、軍主如故。
manualTranslations.literal: In the seventh year he became Western Campaign Chief Clerk under Wang Jingze; general and army commander as before.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he became Western Campaign Chief Clerk under Wang Jingze, retaining his rank as general and army commander.

manualTranslations.zh: 隨府轉驃騎。
manualTranslations.literal: When the headquarters moved he transferred to the Valiant-Cavalry Army.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the headquarters moved he transferred to the Valiant-Cavalry Army.

manualTranslations.zh: 在壽春爲佐數年。
manualTranslations.literal: He served as aide at Shouchun for several years.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He served as aide at Shouchun for several years.

manualTranslations.zh: 九年，爲寧蠻長史、廣平太守。
manualTranslations.literal: In the ninth year he became Chief Clerk of the Southern Barbarians and Administrator of Guangping.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he became Chief Clerk of the Southern Barbarians and Administrator of Guangping.

manualTranslations.zh: 雍州刺史王奐事難，叔業率部曲於城內起義。
manualTranslations.literal: When Wang Huan, Inspector of Yongzhou, met with trouble, Shuye led his private troops in an uprising inside the city.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Wang Huan, Inspector of Yongzhou, fell into crisis, Shuye led his private troops in an uprising inside the city.

manualTranslations.zh: 上以其有幹用，仍留爲晉安王征北諮議，領中兵，扶風太守，遷晉熙王冠軍司馬。

sourceRange.text: 建元元年，虜動，豫章王遣慧景三千人頓方城，爲司州聲援。虜退，梁州賊李烏奴未平，以慧景爲持節、都督梁南北秦沙四州軍事、西戎校尉、梁南秦二州刺史，將軍如故。敕荊州資給發遣，配以實甲千人，步道從襄陽之鎮。初，烏奴屢爲官軍所破，走氐中，乘閒出，擾動梁、漢，據關城。遣使詣荊州請降，豫章王不許。遣中兵參軍王圖南率益州軍從劔閣掩討，大摧破之，烏奴還保武興。慧景發漢中兵衆，進頓白馬。遣支軍與圖南腹背攻擊，烏奴大敗，遂奔于武興。

context.afterSource: 世祖卽位，進號冠軍將軍。

manualTranslations.idiomatic: He sent a detached force to attack together with Tuanan from front and rear; Wunu was heavily defeated and fled to Wuxing.

sourceRange.text: 吳苞字天蓋，濮陽鄄城人也。儒學，善《三禮》及《老》、《莊》。宋泰始中，過江聚徒教學。冠黃葛巾，竹麈尾，蔬食二十餘年。隆昌元年，詔曰：「處士濮陽吳苞，栖志穹谷，秉操貞固，沈情味古，白首彌厲。徵太學博士。」不就。始安王遙光、右衞江祏於蔣山南爲立館，自劉瓛卒後，學者咸歸之。以壽終。

manualTranslations.literal: Sengshao's younger brother Qingfu was governor of Qing Province; Sengshao lacked food and followed Qingfu to Yuzhou, dwelling on Mount Yanyu at the Qiyun Hermitage, delighting in water and rocks, and never once entering the provincial city.

manualTranslations.zh: 永明元年，會稽永興倪翼之母丁氏，少喪夫，性仁愛，遭年荒，分衣食以飴里中饑餓者，隣里求借，未嘗違。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Yongming, Lady Ding, mother of Ni Yi of Yongxing in Kuaiji commandery, lost her husband while young; by nature kind and loving, in a year of famine she divided food and clothing to feed hungry people in the neighborhood, and when neighbors asked to borrow she never refused.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Yongming, Lady Ding, mother of Ni Yi of Yongxing in Kuaiji commandery, was widowed young. Kind by nature, in a famine year she shared food and clothing with hungry neighbors and never refused a request to borrow.

manualTranslations.zh: 同里陳穰父母死，孤單無親戚，丁氏收養之，及長，爲營婚娶。
manualTranslations.literal: Chen Rang of the same village lost both parents and was alone without kin; Lady Ding took him in and raised him, and when he grew up she arranged his marriage.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When fellow villager Chen Rang was orphaned and without kin, Lady Ding raised him and, when he came of age, arranged his marriage.

manualTranslations.zh: 又同里王禮妻徐氏，荒年客死山陰，丁爲買棺器，自往歛葬。
manualTranslations.literal: Also Wang Li's wife Xu of the same village died as a traveler in Shanyin during a famine year; Ding bought coffin and burial goods and went in person to collect and bury her.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Also in the same village, Wang Li's wife Xu died as a traveler in Shanyin during a famine year; Ding bought a coffin and burial goods and went in person to collect and bury her.

manualTranslations.zh: 元徽末，大雪，商旅斷行，村里比屋饑餓，丁自出鹽米，計口分賦。
manualTranslations.literal: At the end of Yuanhui, heavy snow blocked merchants and travelers; house after house in the village went hungry, and Ding brought out her own salt and grain and distributed it by head count.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the end of the Yuanhui era, heavy snow stopped travel; house after house in the village went hungry. Ding brought out her own salt and grain and distributed it by head count.

manualTranslations.zh: 同里左僑家露四喪，無以葬，丁爲辦塚槨。
manualTranslations.literal: The family of Zuo Qiao of the same village had four bodies exposed without means to bury them; Ding provided graves and coffins.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Fellow villager Zuo Qiao's family had four unburied dead and no means to bury them; Ding provided coffins and graves.

manualTranslations.zh: 有三調不登者，代爲輸送。
manualTranslations.literal: For those who could not pay the three levies, she paid them on their behalf.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: For neighbors who could not pay the three levies, she paid them on their behalf.

manualTranslations.zh: 丁長子婦王氏守寡執志不再醮。
manualTranslations.literal: Lady Wang, wife of Ding's eldest son, kept her widowhood and held to her resolve not to remarry.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Ding's eldest son's wife, Lady Wang, kept her widowhood and vowed not to remarry.

manualTranslations.idiomatic: The province and commandery reported the case; an edict honored their gate with a commemorative placard and remitted their taxes.

sourceRange.text: 建元初，帶東燕令，封新陽縣男，三百戶。轉羽林監，加建威將軍，遷尚書主客郎，太尉中兵參軍，令如故。復以本官兼中書舍人。太祖疾甚，令僧真典遺詔。永明元年，寧喪，起爲建威將軍，尋除南泰山太守，又爲舍人，本官如故。領諸王第事。僧真容貌言吐，雅有士風。世祖嘗目送之，笑曰：「人何必計門戶，紀僧真常貴人所不及。」諸權要中，最被盻遇。除越騎校尉，餘官如故。出爲建武將軍，建康令。還除左右郎將，泰山太守。加先驅使。尋除前軍將軍。遭母喪，開冢得五色兩頭蛇。世祖崩，僧真號泣思慕。明帝以僧真歷朝驅使，建武元年，除游擊將軍，兼司農，待之如舊。欲令僧真治郡，僧真啓進其弟僧猛爲鎮蠻護軍、晉熙太守。永泰元年，除司農卿。明帝崩，掌山陵事。出爲廬陵內史，年五十五，卒。

sourceRange.text: 宋世其國相希利垔解星筭數術，通胡、漢語，常言南方當有姓名齊者，其人當興。昇明二年，太祖輔政，遣驍騎將軍王洪（軌）〔範〕使芮芮，剋期共伐魏虜。建元元年八月，芮芮主發三十萬騎南侵，去平城七百里，魏虜拒守不敢戰，芮芮主於燕然山下縱獵而歸。上初踐阼，不遑出師。

manualTranslations.literal: In the Song era their state chancellor Xili'an understood star calculation and number arts, knew both Hu and Han speech, and often said that in the south there would be one whose surname and given name were Qi, and that man would rise.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: During Song times their state chancellor Xili'an mastered astrology and mathematics, spoke both Hu and Chinese, and often said that in the south there would be a man surnamed Qi who would rise to power.

manualTranslations.zh: 昇明二年，太祖輔政，遣驍騎將軍王洪範使芮芮，剋期共伐魏虜。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second year of Shengming, while the Founding Emperor assisted in government, he sent General of Valiant Cavalry Wang Hongfan as envoy to Rouran to fix a date for a joint attack on the Wei barbarians.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second year of Shengming, while the Founding Emperor held the regency, he sent General of Valiant Cavalry Wang Hongfan to Rouran to arrange a joint campaign against the Northern Wei.

manualTranslations.zh: 建元元年八月，芮芮主發三十萬騎南侵，去平城七百里，魏虜拒守不敢戰，芮芮主於燕然山下縱獵而歸。
manualTranslations.literal: In the eighth month of the first year of Jianyuan, the Rouran lord sent three hundred thousand horsemen south in invasion, coming within seven hundred li of Pingcheng; the Wei barbarians defended and dared not fight, and the Rouran lord hunted beneath Mount Yanran and returned.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the first year of Jianyuan, the Rouran ruler sent three hundred thousand horsemen south as far as seven hundred li from Pingcheng; the Northern Wei held their defenses and would not give battle, and the Rouran ruler hunted below Mount Yanran and withdrew.

manualTranslations.zh: 上初踐阼，不遑出師。
manualTranslations.literal: When the emperor first ascended the throne, he had no leisure to take the field.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the emperor first took the throne, he had no time to march out in person.

sourceRange.text: 」世祖即位，進後起號冠軍將軍。永明元年，以征虜將軍炅為沙州刺史、陰平王，將軍如故。二年，八座奏，後起（勒）〔勤〕彰款塞，忠著邊城。進號征虜將軍。四年，後起卒，詔曰：「後起奄至殞逝，惻愴于懷。綏禦邊服，宜詳其選。行輔國將軍、北秦州刺史、武都王楊集始，幹局沈亮，乃心忠款，必能緝境寧民、宣揚聲教。可持節、輔國將軍、北秦州刺史、平羌校尉、武都王。」後起弟後明為龍驤將軍、白水太守。集始弟集朗為寧朔將軍。五年，有司奏集始驅狐剪棘，仰化邊服。母以子貴，宜加榮寵。除集始母姜氏為太夫人，假銀印。九年，八座奏，楊炅嗣勤西牧，馳款內昭，宜增戎章，用輝遐外。進號前將軍。

context.beforeSource: 卿若能襲破白水，必加厚賞。
context.afterSource: 十年，集始反，率氐、蜀雜眾寇漢川，梁州刺史陰智伯遣軍主寧朔將軍桓盧奴、梁季羣、宋□、王士隆等千餘人拒之，不利，退保白馬。

manualTranslations.literal: When Emperor Shizu took the throne, Houqi's title was advanced to General of the Champion.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Emperor Wu took the throne, Houqi was promoted to general of the champion.

manualTranslations.zh: 永明元年，以征虜將軍炅為沙州刺史、陰平王，將軍如故。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Yongming, General Who Punishes the Barbarians Jiong was made Inspector of Shazhou and King of Yinping, his general's rank unchanged.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Yongming, General Who Punishes the Barbarians Jiong was appointed Inspector of Shazhou and King of Yinping, retaining his general's rank.

manualTranslations.zh: 二年，八座奏，後起勤彰款塞，忠著邊城。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second year the Eight Seats memorialized that Houqi's diligence showed sincerity at the frontier and loyalty was manifest on the border walls.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second year the Eight Seats reported that Houqi's diligence had shown frontier loyalty and won renown on the border.

manualTranslations.zh: 進號征虜將軍。
manualTranslations.literal: His title was advanced to General Who Punishes the Barbarians.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was promoted to general who punishes the barbarians.

manualTranslations.zh: 四年，後起卒，詔曰：「後起奄至殞逝，惻愴于懷。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fourth year Houqi died; an edict said: "Houqi has suddenly reached death and fallen away; We are deeply grieved at heart.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fourth year Houqi died; an edict read: "Houqi has died suddenly, and We are deeply grieved.

manualTranslations.zh: 綏禦邊服，宜詳其選。
manualTranslations.literal: To soothe and guard the frontier regions, the choice should be carefully considered.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: To guard the frontier, the appointment must be carefully chosen.

manualTranslations.zh: 行輔國將軍、北秦州刺史、武都王楊集始，幹局沈亮，乃心忠款，必能緝境寧民、宣揚聲教。
manualTranslations.literal: Acting General Who Assists the State, Inspector of Northern Qinzhou, and King of Wudu Yang Jishi is deep and bright in capacity, loyal and sincere at heart, and can surely bring the borders to order, settle the people, and spread civilizing instruction.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Acting General Who Assists the State, Inspector of Northern Qin, and King of Wudu Yang Jishi is capable and steadfastly loyal, and will surely pacify the frontier, settle the people, and spread imperial instruction.

manualTranslations.zh: 可持節、輔國將軍、北秦州刺史、平羌校尉、武都王。」
manualTranslations.literal: He may be Bearer of the Staff, General Who Assists the State, Inspector of Northern Qinzhou, Colonel Who Pacifies the Qiang, and King of Wudu."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He is appointed Bearer of the Staff, General Who Assists the State, Inspector of Northern Qin, Colonel Who Pacifies the Qiang, and King of Wudu."

manualTranslations.zh: 後起弟後明為龍驤將軍、白水太守。
manualTranslations.literal: Houqi's younger brother Houming was made General of the Flying Dragon and Administrator of Baishui.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Houqi's younger brother Houming was appointed general of the flying dragon and administrator of Baishui.

manualTranslations.zh: 集始弟集朗為寧朔將軍。
manualTranslations.literal: Jishi's younger brother Jilang was made General Who Pacifies the North.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Jishi's younger brother Jilang was appointed general who pacifies the north.

manualTranslations.zh: 五年，有司奏集始驅狐剪棘，仰化邊服。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fifth year the responsible offices memorialized that Jishi had driven off foxes and cut brambles, looking up to transformation on the frontier.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fifth year the responsible offices reported that Jishi had cleared the frontier and won the border peoples' allegiance.

manualTranslations.zh: 母以子貴，宜加榮寵。
manualTranslations.literal: Because the mother is ennobled through the son, added honor and favor are fitting.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: As the mother is ennobled through her son, added honors are fitting.

manualTranslations.zh: 除集始母姜氏為太夫人，假銀印。
manualTranslations.literal: Jishi's mother, Lady Jiang, was appointed Grand Lady and given a provisional silver seal.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Jishi's mother, Lady Jiang, was made Grand Lady and granted a provisional silver seal.

manualTranslations.zh: 九年，八座奏，楊炅嗣勤西牧，馳款內昭，宜增戎章，用輝遐外。
manualTranslations.literal: In the ninth year the Eight Seats memorialized that Yang Jiong succeeded in diligence on the western pastures, hastening sincerity inward to make it manifest, and that military honors should be increased to shine on the distant marches.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the ninth year the Eight Seats reported that Yang Jiong had continued his loyal service on the western frontier and that his military honors should be increased to shine abroad.

manualTranslations.zh: 進號前將軍。
manualTranslations.literal: His title was advanced to General of the Vanguard.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was promoted to general of the vanguard.

sourceRange.text: 太祖即位，欲綏懷異俗。建元元年，詔曰：「昔絕國入贄，美稱前冊，殊俗內款，聲流往記。偽虜茄蘆鎮主、陰平郡公楊廣香，怨結同族，舋起親黨，當宋之世，遂舉地降敵。茄蘆失守，華陽暫驚。近單使先馳，宣揚皇威，廣香等追其遠世之誠，仰〔我〕惟新之化，肉袒請附，復地千里，氐羌雜種，咸同歸從。宜時領納，厚加優卹。廣香翻迷反正，可特量所授。部曲酋豪，隨名酬賞。」以廣香為督沙州諸軍事、平羌校尉、沙州刺史。尋進號征虜將軍。

manualTranslations.zh: 太祖即位，欲綏懷異俗。
manualTranslations.literal: When the Founding Emperor took the throne, he wished to soothe and cherish foreign peoples.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the Founding Emperor took the throne, he sought to win over foreign peoples.

manualTranslations.zh: 建元元年，詔曰：「昔絕國入贄，美稱前冊，殊俗內款，聲流往記。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Jianyuan, an edict said: "In former times distant states entered with tribute, praised in earlier annals; foreign peoples submitted inwardly, their fame flowing in past records.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Jianyuan, an edict read: "In former times distant states brought tribute and won praise in earlier annals; foreign peoples submitted and their fame filled past records.

manualTranslations.zh: 偽虜茄蘆鎮主、陰平郡公楊廣香，怨結同族，舋起親黨，當宋之世，遂舉地降敵。
manualTranslations.literal: The false barbarians' Jialu garrison chief and Duke of Yinping commandery Yang Guangxiang, with grievances binding his clan and trouble rising among kin, in the Song era then raised his lands and surrendered to the enemy.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yang Guangxiang, the Northern Wei commander of Jialu and Duke of Yinping, bound by clan grievances and stirred up by kin, surrendered his territory to the enemy during Song.

manualTranslations.zh: 茄蘆失守，華陽暫驚。
manualTranslations.literal: Jialu was lost and Huayang was briefly alarmed.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Jialu fell and Huayang was briefly thrown into alarm.

manualTranslations.zh: 近單使先馳，宣揚皇威，廣香等追其遠世之誠，仰我惟新之化，肉袒請附，復地千里，氐羌雜種，咸同歸從。
manualTranslations.literal: Recently a lone envoy went ahead, proclaiming imperial majesty; Guangxiang and others recalled the loyalty of distant ages, looked up to Our renewing transformation, bared their torsos to request attachment, restored a thousand li of territory, and Di and Qiang mixed stocks all alike returned in submission.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Recently a lone envoy went ahead to proclaim imperial majesty; Guangxiang and others recalled their ancient loyalty, looked to Our renewing rule, came bare-chested to submit, restored a thousand li of territory, and Di and Qiang tribes alike returned to allegiance.

manualTranslations.zh: 宜時領納，厚加優卹。
manualTranslations.literal: They should promptly be received and generously favored with relief.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: They should be received at once and generously favored.

manualTranslations.zh: 廣香翻迷反正，可特量所授。
manualTranslations.literal: Guangxiang, turning from delusion back to the right, may be specially measured in what is granted.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Guangxiang, having turned from error back to loyalty, should receive a specially measured grant of office.

manualTranslations.zh: 部曲酋豪，隨名酬賞。」
manualTranslations.literal: Chieftains and magnates of his following are to be rewarded according to their names."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Chieftains and leaders of his following are to be rewarded by name."

manualTranslations.zh: 以廣香為督沙州諸軍事、平羌校尉、沙州刺史。
manualTranslations.literal: Guangxiang was made Commander of all military affairs of Shazhou, Colonel Who Pacifies the Qiang, and Inspector of Shazhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Guangxiang was appointed Commander of Military Affairs in Shazhou, Colonel Who Pacifies the Qiang, and Inspector of Shazhou.

manualTranslations.zh: 尋進號征虜將軍。
manualTranslations.literal: Soon his title was advanced to General Who Punishes the Barbarians.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Soon he was promoted to general who punishes the barbarians.

manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Yongming, Wang Hongfan returned to the capital, having traveled more than thirty thousand li.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Yongming, Wang Hongfan returned to the capital after a journey of more than thirty thousand li.

manualTranslations.zh: 洪範，齊郡臨淄人，為太祖所親信。
manualTranslations.literal: Hongfan was a man of Linzi in Qi commandery and was personally trusted by the Founding Emperor.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Hongfan was from Linzi in Qi commandery and enjoyed the Founding Emperor's personal trust.

manualTranslations.zh: 建武中，為青冀二州刺史。
manualTranslations.literal: During Jianwu he was made inspector of the two provinces Qing and Ji.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: During the Jianwu era he served as inspector of Qing and Ji.

manualTranslations.zh: 私占丁侵虜堺，奔敗結氣卒。
manualTranslations.literal: He privately registered households and encroached on the barbarian frontier; fleeing in defeat, he died of pent-up rage.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He privately seized households and encroached on the Wei frontier; after fleeing in defeat he died of choking rage.

sourceRange.text: 建元元年，太祖即本官進號驃騎大將軍。宋世遣武衞將軍王世武使河南，是歲隨拾寅使來獻。詔答曰：「皇帝敬問使持節、散騎常侍、都督西秦河沙三州諸軍事、車騎大將軍、開府儀同三司、領護羌校尉、西秦河二州刺史、新除驃騎大將軍、河南王：寶命革授，爰集朕躬，猥當大業，祗惕兼懷。夏中增感。王世武至，得元徽五年五月二十一日表，聞之濕熱，想比平安。又卿乃誠遙著，保寧遐壃。今詔升徽號，以酬忠款。遣王世武銜命拜授。又仍使王世武等往芮芮，想即資遣，使得時達。又奏所上馬等物悉至，今往別牒錦絳紫碧綠黃青等紋各十匹。

context.beforeSource: 宋初始受爵命，至宋末，河南王吐谷渾拾寅為使持節、散騎常侍、都督西秦河沙三州諸軍事、車騎大將軍、開府儀同三司、領護羌校尉、西秦河二州刺史。
context.afterSource: 」拾寅子易度侯好星文，甞求星書，朝議不給。

manualTranslations.zh: 建元元年，太祖即本官進號驃騎大將軍。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Jianyuan, the Founding Emperor advanced from his existing office to General of Agile Cavalry.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Jianyuan, the Founding Emperor was promoted from his existing post to general of agile cavalry.

manualTranslations.zh: 宋世遣武衞將軍王世武使河南，是歲隨拾寅使來獻。
manualTranslations.literal: In the Song era they sent General of the Martial Guard Wang Shiwu as envoy to Henan; that year he came with Shiyin's envoy to present tribute.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: During Song, General of the Martial Guard Wang Shiwu was sent to Henan; that year he came with Shiyin's envoy bearing tribute.

manualTranslations.zh: 詔答曰：「皇帝敬問使持節、散騎常侍、都督西秦河沙三州諸軍事、車騎大將軍、開府儀同三司、領護羌校尉、西秦河二州刺史、新除驃騎大將軍、河南王：寶命革授，爰集朕躬，猥當大業，祗惕兼懷。
manualTranslations.literal: An edict replied: "The emperor respectfully inquires of the Bearer of the Staff, Regular Attendant of the Scattered Cavalry, Commander of all military affairs of the three provinces Xi-Qin-He-Sha, General of Chariots and Cavalry, Grand Master opening an office equal to the Three Excellencies, Colonel Protector of the Qiang, Inspector of the two provinces Xi-Qin-He, and newly appointed General of Agile Cavalry, King of Henan: the precious mandate has been changed and conferred and has gathered upon Our person; unworthily We bear the great enterprise, reverent and fearful together.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: An edict replied: "The emperor respectfully greets the Bearer of the Staff, Regular Attendant of the Scattered Cavalry, Commander of Military Affairs in Western Qin, He, and Sha, General of Chariots and Cavalry, Grand Master with an office equal to the Three Excellencies, Colonel Protector of the Qiang, Inspector of Western Qin and He, and newly appointed General of Agile Cavalry, King of Henan: the sacred mandate has passed to Us, and unworthily We bear the great task with reverence and fear.

manualTranslations.zh: 夏中增感。
manualTranslations.literal: In midsummer Our feeling increased.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In midsummer Our feelings deepened.

manualTranslations.zh: 王世武至，得元徽五年五月二十一日表，聞之濕熱，想比平安。
manualTranslations.literal: Wang Shiwu arrived and We received the memorial of the twenty-first day of the fifth month of the fifth year of Yuanhui; hearing of the damp heat, We trust you are comparatively safe.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Wang Shiwu arrived with your memorial dated the twenty-first day of the fifth month of Yuanhui 5; hearing of the damp heat there, We trust you remain safe.

manualTranslations.zh: 又卿乃誠遙著，保寧遐壃。
manualTranslations.literal: Moreover your loyalty shines from afar, guarding and pacifying the distant frontier.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Your loyalty shines from afar, guarding and pacifying the distant frontier.

manualTranslations.zh: 今詔升徽號，以酬忠款。
manualTranslations.literal: Now We decree advancement of your honored title to repay loyal sincerity.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: We now decree the advancement of your title in reward for your loyalty.

manualTranslations.zh: 遣王世武銜命拜授。
manualTranslations.literal: We send Wang Shiwu bearing the mandate to invest you.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: We send Wang Shiwu with the commission to invest you.

manualTranslations.zh: 又仍使王世武等往芮芮，想即資遣，使得時達。
manualTranslations.literal: We also again send Wang Shiwu and others to Rouran; We trust you will promptly supply and dispatch them so they may arrive in time.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: We also send Wang Shiwu and others on to Rouran; please supply and dispatch them promptly so they may arrive in time.

manualTranslations.zh: 又奏所上馬等物悉至，今往別牒錦絳紫碧綠黃青等紋各十匹。
manualTranslations.literal: Your memorial that the horses and other goods presented have all arrived is noted; by separate dispatch We now send brocades in crimson, purple, blue-green, green, yellow, and blue patterns, ten bolts each.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: We note your report that the horses and other tribute have all arrived; by separate dispatch We send brocades in crimson, purple, blue-green, green, yellow, and blue, ten bolts of each.

sourceRange.text: 誠効顯著，寔有可嘉。

localRange.text: 誠效顯著，寔有可嘉。

sourceRange.text: 宕昌，羌種也。各有酋豪，領部眾汧、隴閒。宋末，宕昌王梁彌機為使持節、督河涼二州、安西將軍、東羌校尉、河涼二州刺史、隴西公。建元元年，太祖進號鎮西將軍。又征虜將軍、西涼州刺史羌王像舒彭亦進為持節、平西將軍。後叛降〔虜〕。永明元年，八座奏，前使持節、都督河涼二州軍事、鎮西將軍，東羌校尉、河涼二州刺史、隴西公、宕昌王梁彌機，前使持節、平北將軍、西涼州刺史、羌王像舒彭，竝著勤西垂，寧安邊境，可復先官爵。詔又可以隴右都帥羌王劉洛羊為輔國將軍。

context.beforeSource: 宋以仇池為郡，故以氐封焉。
context.afterSource: 機卒。
context.beforeLocal: 宋以仇池爲郡，故以氐封焉。
context.afterLocal: 機卒。

manualTranslations.literal: Dangchang was a Qiang stock.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Dangchang was a Qiang people.

manualTranslations.zh: 各有酋豪，領部眾汧、隴閒。
manualTranslations.literal: Each had chieftains and magnates leading their hosts between Qian and Long.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Each tribe had chieftains leading their followers between the Qian and Long region.

manualTranslations.zh: 宋末，宕昌王梁彌機為使持節、督河涼二州、安西將軍、東羌校尉、河涼二州刺史、隴西公。
manualTranslations.literal: At the end of Song, King of Dangchang Liang Miji was Bearer of the Staff, Commander of the two provinces He and Liang, General Who Pacifies the West, Colonel of the Eastern Qiang, Inspector of the two provinces He and Liang, and Duke of Longxi.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the end of Song, King of Dangchang Liang Miji held the posts of Bearer of the Staff, Commander of He and Liang, General Who Pacifies the West, Colonel of the Eastern Qiang, Inspector of He and Liang, and Duke of Longxi.

manualTranslations.zh: 建元元年，太祖進號鎮西將軍。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Jianyuan, the Founding Emperor advanced his title to General Who Guards the West.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Jianyuan, the Founding Emperor promoted him to general who guards the west.

manualTranslations.zh: 又征虜將軍、西涼州刺史羌王像舒彭亦進為持節、平西將軍。
manualTranslations.literal: Also General Who Punishes the Barbarians and Inspector of Xiliangzhou, the Qiang king Xiang Shupeng, was likewise advanced to Bearer of the Staff and General Who Pacifies the West.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Qiang king Xiang Shupeng, general who punishes the barbarians and inspector of Xiliang, was likewise promoted to bearer of the staff and general who pacifies the west.

manualTranslations.zh: 後叛降虜。
manualTranslations.literal: Later he rebelled and surrendered to the barbarians.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Later he rebelled and surrendered to the Wei.

manualTranslations.zh: 永明元年，八座奏，前使持節、都督河涼二州軍事、鎮西將軍，東羌校尉、河涼二州刺史、隴西公、宕昌王梁彌機，前使持節、平北將軍、西涼州刺史、羌王像舒彭，竝著勤西垂，寧安邊境，可復先官爵。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Yongming the Eight Seats memorialized that the former Bearer of the Staff, Commander of military affairs of the two provinces He and Liang, General Who Guards the West, Colonel of the Eastern Qiang, Inspector of the two provinces He and Liang, Duke of Longxi, and King of Dangchang Liang Miji, and the former Bearer of the Staff, General Who Pacifies the North, Inspector of Xiliangzhou, and Qiang king Xiang Shupeng, had both shown diligence on the western marches and secured and pacified the frontier, and their former offices and titles might be restored.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Yongming the Eight Seats reported that the former King of Dangchang Liang Miji and the former Qiang king Xiang Shupeng had both served faithfully on the western frontier and secured the border, and that their former offices and titles should be restored.

manualTranslations.zh: 詔又可以隴右都帥羌王劉洛羊為輔國將軍。
manualTranslations.literal: An edict also made the Longyou commander-in-chief and Qiang king Liu Luoyang General Who Assists the State.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: An edict also appointed Longyou commander Liu Luoyang, king of the Qiang, general who assists the state.
